      {
        "id": "article-Art14-Para10",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 14,
        "paragraph_number": "10",
        "article_heading": "Reporting obligations of manufacturers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Reporting obligations of manufacturers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission may, by means of implementing acts, specify further the format and procedures of the notifications referred to in this Article as well as in Articles 15 and 16. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 62(2). The Commission shall cooperate with the CSIRTs network and ENISA in preparing those draft implementing acts.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art14-Para10",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 66,
        "source_pinpoint": 14,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art14-Para10"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "890eb2aec1dd534a16ae74685eec731f0eb9a374556e563ded4c67303628602b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art15-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 15,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Manufacturers as well as other natural or legal persons may notify any vulnerability contained in a product with digital elements as well as cyber threats that could affect the risk profile of a product with digital elements on a voluntary basis to a CSIRT designated as coordinator or ENISA.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art15-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 67,
        "source_pinpoint": 15,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art15-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "5aad8d5f9c86d861bd3f3e67b1ffe6eb6afb49e69402fbd94c31817db8e4ea30",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art15-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 15,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Manufacturers as well as other natural or legal persons may notify any incident having an impact on the security of the product with digital elements as well as near misses that could have resulted in such an incident on a voluntary basis to a CSIRT designated as coordinator or ENISA.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art15-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 68,
        "source_pinpoint": 15,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art15-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f5c4182400d36ae7219952a0ec5f4e93b63cf2a4ff0acf8ed1070abc54506529",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art15-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 15,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The CSIRT designated as coordinator or ENISA shall process the notifications referred to in paragraphs 1 and 2 of this Article in accordance with the procedure laid down in Article 16. The CSIRT designated as coordinator may prioritise the processing of mandatory notifications over voluntary notifications.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art15-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 69,
        "source_pinpoint": 15,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art15-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "860bb5db3a8deee1c5b9ff9a4cfa8bd690251a93ed62a22f307453ef23a599e5",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art15-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 15,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where a natural or legal person other than the manufacturer notifies an actively exploited vulnerability or a severe incident having an impact on the security of a product with digital elements in accordance with paragraph 1 or 2, the CSIRT designated as coordinator shall without undue delay inform the manufacturer.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art15-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 70,
        "source_pinpoint": 15,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art15-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "e7c0778146c313a4fd7de59d350e59725d7c2160dc92ef6de1ee583b599ce1a6",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art15-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 15,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Voluntary reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The CSIRTs designated as coordinators as well as ENISA shall ensure the confidentiality and appropriate protection of the information provided by a notifying natural or legal person. Without prejudice to the prevention, investigation, detection and prosecution of criminal offences, voluntary reporting shall not result in the imposition of any additional obligations upon a notifying natural or legal person to which it would not have been subject had it not submitted the notification.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art15-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 71,
        "source_pinpoint": 15,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art15-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "cadeedf9e37fcd5af9c7f78f48af6eea1204499388be6753c0ceeeca10e74983",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art16-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 16,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "For the purposes of the notifications referred to in Article 14(1) and (3) and Article 15(1) and (2) and in order to simplify the reporting obligations of manufacturers, a single reporting platform shall be established by ENISA. The day-to-day operations of that single reporting platform shall be managed and maintained by ENISA. The architecture of the single reporting platform shall allow Member States and ENISA to put in place their own electronic notification end-points.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art16-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 72,
        "source_pinpoint": 16,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art16-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "213ec9b4f8eed6875ade8895b59136bb20fe682b769732b4aa691dc3faf0d7a7",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art16-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 16,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "that the notified vulnerability has been actively exploited by a malicious actor and, according to the information available, it has been exploited in no other Member State than the one of the CSIRT designated as coordinator to which the manufacturer has notified the vulnerability;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "that any immediate further dissemination of the notified vulnerability would likely result in the supply of information the disclosure of which would be contrary to the essential interests of that Member State; or"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "that the notified vulnerability poses an imminent high cybersecurity risk stemming from the further dissemination; only the information that a notification was made by the manufacturer, the general information about the product, the information on the general nature of the exploit and the information that security related grounds were raised are to be made available simultaneously to ENISA until the full notification is disseminated to the CSIRTs concerned and ENISA. Where, based on that information, ENISA considers that there is a systemic risk affecting security in the internal market, it shall recommend to the recipient CSIRT that it disseminate the full notification to the other CSIRTs designated as coordinators and to ENISA itself."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "After receiving a notification, the CSIRT designated as coordinator initially receiving the notification shall, without delay, disseminate the notification via the single reporting platform to the CSIRTs designated as coordinators on the territory of which the manufacturer has indicated that the product with digital elements has been made available. In exceptional circumstances and, in particular, upon request by the manufacturer and in light of the level of sensitivity of the notified information as indicated by the manufacturer under Article 14(2), point (a), of this Regulation, the dissemination of the notification may be delayed based on justified cybersecurity-related grounds for a period of time that is strictly necessary, including where a vulnerability is subject to a coordinated vulnerability disclosure procedure as referred to in Article 12(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Where a CSIRT decides to withhold a notification, it shall immediately inform ENISA about the decision and provide both a justification for withholding the notification as well as an indication of when it will disseminate the notification in accordance with the dissemination procedure laid down in this paragraph. ENISA may support the CSIRT on the application of cybersecurity-related grounds in relation to delaying the dissemination of the notification. In particularly exceptional circumstances, where the manufacturer indicates in the notification referred to in Article 14(2), point (b): (a) that the notified vulnerability has been actively exploited by a malicious actor and, according to the information available, it has been exploited in no other Member State than the one of the CSIRT designated as coordinator to which the manufacturer has notified the vulnerability; (b) that any immediate further dissemination of the notified vulnerability would likely result in the supply of information the disclosure of which would be contrary to the essential interests of that Member State; or (c) that the notified vulnerability poses an imminent high cybersecurity risk stemming from the further dissemination; only the information that a notification was made by the manufacturer, the general information about the product, the information on the general nature of the exploit and the information that security related grounds were raised are to be made available simultaneously to ENISA until the full notification is disseminated to the CSIRTs concerned and ENISA. Where, based on that information, ENISA considers that there is a systemic risk affecting security in the internal market, it shall recommend to the recipient CSIRT that it disseminate the full notification to the other CSIRTs designated as coordinators and to ENISA itself.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art16-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 73,
        "source_pinpoint": 16,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art16-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "29ee00ce6e014fb9ae33bb2e990c87509c4840ba8e8cc6048f2865cf0ff0b3dd",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art16-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 16,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "After receiving a notification of an actively exploited vulnerability in a product with digital elements or of a severe incident having an impact on the security of a product with digital elements, the CSIRTs designated as coordinators shall provide the market surveillance authorities of their respective Member States with the notified information necessary for the market surveillance authorities to fulfil their obligations under this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art16-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 74,
        "source_pinpoint": 16,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art16-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "78617c293e5d9ba3a47f18c80a63870bbeefd24210e1fbf88862ff397a26fae6",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art16-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 16,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "ENISA shall take appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures to manage the risks posed to the security of the single reporting platform and the information submitted or disseminated via the single reporting platform. It shall notify without undue delay any security incident affecting the single reporting platform to the CSIRTs network as well as to the Commission.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art16-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 75,
        "source_pinpoint": 16,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art16-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "5765049840a11cfde80ca905a51f4970065cf954630ab2315d5d79fa0a2134c8",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art16-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 16,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "ENISA, in cooperation with the CSIRTs network, shall provide and implement specifications on the technical, operational and organisational measures regarding the establishment, maintenance and secure operation of the single reporting platform referred to in paragraph 1, including at least the security arrangements related to the establishment, operation and maintenance of the single reporting platform, as well as the electronic notification end-points set up by the CSIRTs designated as coordinators at national level and ENISA at Union level, including procedural aspects to ensure that, where a notified vulnerability has no corrective or mitigating measures available, information about that vulnerability is shared in line with strict security protocols and on a need-to-know basis.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art16-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 76,
        "source_pinpoint": 16,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art16-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6f5cfc4dc8e177e538983d2f1aa01d04fc12539555e20462874d6c414ff7e37a",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art16-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 16,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Establishment of a single reporting platform",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where a CSIRT designated as coordinator has been made aware of an actively exploited vulnerability as part of a coordinated vulnerability disclosure procedure as referred to in Article 12(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555, the CSIRT designated as coordinator initially receiving the notification may delay the dissemination of the relevant notification via the single reporting platform based on justified cybersecurity-related grounds for a period that is no longer than is strictly necessary and until consent for disclosure by the involved coordinated vulnerability disclosure parties is given. That requirement shall not prevent manufacturers from notifying such a vulnerability on a voluntary basis in accordance with the procedure laid down in this Article.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art16-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 77,
        "source_pinpoint": 16,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art16-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "41f59d71208d7375fa96426bf95324de89e3cfae02d7d214735e07f00bd4ce49",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art17-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 17,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "ENISA may submit to the European cyber crisis liaison organisation network (EU-CyCLONe) established under Article 16 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555 information notified pursuant to Article 14(1) and (3) and Article 15(1) and (2) of this Regulation if such information is relevant for the coordinated management of large-scale cybersecurity incidents and crises at an operational level. For the purpose of determining such relevance, ENISA may consider technical analyses performed by the CSIRTs network, where available.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art17-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 78,
        "source_pinpoint": 17,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art17-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "e2a19a327256f099ee7e59ae54d7ee14a16aec8333753ee6fee68f040c07df3f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art17-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 17,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where public awareness is necessary to prevent or mitigate a severe incident having an impact on the security of the product with digital elements or to handle an ongoing incident, or where disclosure of the incident is otherwise in the public interest, the CSIRT designated as coordinator of the relevant Member State may, after consulting the manufacturer concerned and, where appropriate, in cooperation with ENISA, inform the public about the incident or require the manufacturer to do so.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art17-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 79,
        "source_pinpoint": 17,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art17-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "07855d85786ab24ace06a5bc224a4e022a364873bd23163b9fd7110d736e5635",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art17-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 17,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "ENISA, on the basis of the notifications received pursuant to Article 14(1) and (3) and Article 15(1) and (2) of this Regulation, shall prepare, every 24 months, a technical report on emerging trends regarding cybersecurity risks in products with digital elements and submit it to the Cooperation Group established pursuant to Article 14 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555. The first such report shall be submitted within 24 months of the date of application of the obligations laid down in Article 14(1) and (3) of this Regulation. ENISA shall include relevant information from its technical reports in its report on the state of cybersecurity in the Union pursuant to Article 18 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art17-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 80,
        "source_pinpoint": 17,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art17-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "cdd341c8f60a75a61a29f352a433f78e52670d4bc792e3211a15e57ebd244b79",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art17-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 17,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The mere act of notification in accordance with Article 14(1) and (3) or Article 15(1) and (2) shall not subject the notifying natural or legal person to increased liability.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art17-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 81,
        "source_pinpoint": 17,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art17-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"

        "text_sha256": "3f58e602eb4af5de6df3e5307cdf2582d6c9217d5b293232eb72ce43a1ce5aab",

      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art17-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 17,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "After a security update or another form of corrective or mitigating measure is available, ENISA shall, in agreement with the manufacturer of the product with digital elements concerned, add the publicly known vulnerability notified pursuant to Article 14(1) or Article 15(1) of this Regulation to the European vulnerability database established pursuant to Article 12(2) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art17-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 82,
        "source_pinpoint": 17,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art17-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "a5df6213001b6d2d34b70ceac328b2568f10c3ef2a02f433943c7cc5a9760775",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art17-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 17,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other provisions related to reporting",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The CSIRTs designated as coordinators shall provide helpdesk support in relation to the reporting obligations pursuant to Article 14 to manufacturers and in particular manufacturers that qualify as microenterprises or as small or medium-sized enterprises.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art17-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 83,
        "source_pinpoint": 17,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art17-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "e916e66c108104b2861df17036517eab62f5ee6ea9b3a2f9fb37aed1c4496e97",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art18-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 18,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Authorised representatives",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Authorised representatives",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "A manufacturer may, by a written mandate, appoint an authorised representative.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art18-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 84,
        "source_pinpoint": 18,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art18-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "a987878290d282eaf5e923b8932751ce380e056f130ba7e86fe306f4f056cdb0",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art18-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 18,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Authorised representatives",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Authorised representatives",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The obligations laid down in Article 13(1) to (11), Article 13(12), first subparagraph, and Article 13(14) shall not form part of the authorised representative’s mandate.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art18-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 85,
        "source_pinpoint": 18,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art18-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "82131ebd15273ce008fbd9c82d9f1a73fa80d2332ec4ca6dab6c2de0434dfc12",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art18-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 18,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Authorised representatives",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Authorised representatives",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "keep the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 28 and the technical documentation referred to in Article 31 at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the product with digital elements has been placed on the market or for the support period, whichever is longer;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "further to a reasoned request from a market surveillance authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the product with digital elements;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "cooperate with the market surveillance authorities, at their request, on any action taken to eliminate the risks posed by a product with digital elements covered by the authorised representative’s mandate."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "An authorised representative shall perform the tasks specified in the mandate received from the manufacturer. The authorised representative shall provide a copy of the mandate to the market surveillance authorities upon request. The mandate shall allow the authorised representative to do at least the following: (a) keep the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 28 and the technical documentation referred to in Article 31 at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities for at least 10 years after the product with digital elements has been placed on the market or for the support period, whichever is longer; (b) further to a reasoned request from a market surveillance authority, provide that authority with all the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the product with digital elements; (c) cooperate with the market surveillance authorities, at their request, on any action taken to eliminate the risks posed by a product with digital elements covered by the authorised representative’s mandate.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art18-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 86,
        "source_pinpoint": 18,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art18-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "e0daf962d5c5548a0807b5850dd018fcfaab4d3c38256ee50fad73924e61ee0d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Importers shall place on the market only products with digital elements that comply with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part I of Annex I and where the processes put in place by the manufacturer comply with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part II of Annex I.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 87,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6b10f25e0383b4424ffdf7b8d7733b42845b7e928d6caded265b09f3693cdd32",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the appropriate conformity assessment procedures as referred to in Article 32 have been carried out by the manufacturer;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "the manufacturer has drawn up the technical documentation;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "the product with digital elements bears the CE marking referred to in Article 30 and is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 13(20) and the information and instructions to the user as set out in Annex II in a language which can be easily understood by users and market surveillance authorities;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(d)",
            "text": "the manufacturer has complied with the requirements set out in Article 13(15), (16) and (19). For the purposes of this paragraph, importers shall be able to provide the necessary documents proving the fulfilment of the requirements set out in this Article."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Before placing a product with digital elements on the market, importers shall ensure that: (a) the appropriate conformity assessment procedures as referred to in Article 32 have been carried out by the manufacturer; (b) the manufacturer has drawn up the technical documentation; (c) the product with digital elements bears the CE marking referred to in Article 30 and is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 13(20) and the information and instructions to the user as set out in Annex II in a language which can be easily understood by users and market surveillance authorities; (d) the manufacturer has complied with the requirements set out in Article 13(15), (16) and (19). For the purposes of this paragraph, importers shall be able to provide the necessary documents proving the fulfilment of the requirements set out in this Article.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 88,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "72ee4b2f02b9f7842a238a0a3eb4bfe627ee0abb6e8b0dfa82658b2d75aa3124",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where an importer considers or has reason to believe that a product with digital elements or the processes put in place by the manufacturer are not in conformity with this Regulation, the importer shall not place the product on the market until that product or the processes put in place by the manufacturer have been brought into conformity with this Regulation. Furthermore, where the product with digital elements presents a significant cybersecurity risk, the importer shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities to that effect. Where an importer has reason to believe that a product with digital elements may present a significant cybersecurity risk in light of non-technical risk factors, the importer shall inform the market surveillance authorities to that effect. Upon receipt of such information, the market surveillance authorities shall follow the procedures referred to in Article 54(2).",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 89,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "e251fbe04d87cc713355313333b6039d185cbb1ba97561afa63d0ab1d7defc33",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Importers shall indicate their name, registered trade name or registered trademark, the postal address, email address or other digital contact as well as, where applicable, the website at which they can be contacted on the product with digital elements or on its packaging or in a document accompanying the product with digital elements. The contact details shall be in a language easily understood by users and market surveillance authorities.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 90,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "c41d74e412f1a46b1b3acf53c10c205c7377ad57adc303de13e826de371a482b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Importers who know or have reason to believe that a product with digital elements which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation shall immediately take the corrective measures necessary to ensure that the product with digital elements is brought into conformity with this Regulation, or to withdraw or recall the product, if appropriate. Upon becoming aware of a vulnerability in the product with digital elements, importers shall inform the manufacturer without undue delay about that vulnerability. Furthermore, where the product with digital elements presents a significant cybersecurity risk, importers shall immediately inform the market surveillance authorities of the Member States in which they have made the product with digital elements available on the market to that effect, giving details, in particular, of non-compliance and of any corrective measures taken.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 91,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "336158100ef1a121903be4fe77e4c1fcb14054d6bf5cc8103c40732e732636c3",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Importers shall, for at least 10 years after the product with digital elements has been placed on the market or for the support period, whichever is longer, keep a copy of the EU declaration of conformity at the disposal of the market surveillance authorities and ensure that the technical documentation can be made available to those authorities, upon request.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 92,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "297996e1a06196113d9facf651a4c3584c23bbebf54951224790c438ea809a8b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para7",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "7",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Importers shall, further to a reasoned request from a market surveillance authority, provide it with all the information and documentation, in paper or electronic form, necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the product with digital elements with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part I of Annex I as well as of the processes put in place by the manufacturer with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part II of Annex I in a language that can be easily understood by that authority. They shall cooperate with that authority, at its request, on any measures taken to eliminate the cybersecurity risks posed by a product with digital elements, which they have placed on the market.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para7",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 93,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para7"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "aa1c8da1597efdb9e86033f0395a0de8ce0cb917fe3f846abc42f00a08b62c06",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art19-Para8",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 19,
        "paragraph_number": "8",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of importers",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where the importer of a product with digital elements becomes aware that the manufacturer of that product has ceased its operations and, as result, is not able to comply with the obligations laid down in this Regulation, the importer shall inform the relevant market surveillance authorities about this situation, as well as, by any means available and to the extent possible, the users of the products with digital elements placed on the market.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art19-Para8",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 94,
        "source_pinpoint": 19,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art19-Para8"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "cc330edd5e2f4c56f6b8a9a906a765887fbf19386ca870519f74519b1797841a",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art20-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 20,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "When making a product with digital elements available on the market, distributors shall act with due care in relation to the requirements set out in this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art20-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 95,
        "source_pinpoint": 20,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art20-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "08ff2cd11321369293c796af0f20194989333b7441878d88c3fbc92fd355b643",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art20-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 20,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the product with digital elements bears the CE marking;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "the manufacturer and the importer have complied with the obligations set out in Article 13(15), (16), (18), (19) and (20) and Article 19(4), and have provided all necessary documents to the distributor."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Before making a product with digital elements available on the market, distributors shall verify that: (a) the product with digital elements bears the CE marking; (b) the manufacturer and the importer have complied with the obligations set out in Article 13(15), (16), (18), (19) and (20) and Article 19(4), and have provided all necessary documents to the distributor.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art20-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 96,
        "source_pinpoint": 20,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art20-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "ec3015dac2178faa7c7972124fa73098dd0781cad948abc8f0ce8a5aa66e6747",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art20-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 20,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where a distributor considers or has reason to believe, on the basis of information in its possession, that a product with digital elements or the processes put in place by the manufacturer are not in conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I, the distributor shall not make the product with digital elements available on the market until that product or the processes put in place by the manufacturer have been brought into conformity with this Regulation. Furthermore, where the product with digital elements poses a significant cybersecurity risk, the distributor shall inform, without undue delay, the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities to that effect.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art20-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 97,
        "source_pinpoint": 20,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art20-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "0637885d61a04f505dceb50be14270025f9cdae3c65df20cf824063f90cd7ffe",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art20-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 20,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Distributors who know or have reason to believe, on the basis of information in their possession, that a product with digital elements, which they have made available on the market, or the processes put in place by its manufacturer are not in conformity with this Regulation shall make sure that the corrective measures necessary to bring that product with digital elements or the processes put in place by its manufacturer into conformity, or to withdraw or recall the product, if appropriate, are taken. Upon becoming aware of a vulnerability in the product with digital elements, distributors shall inform the manufacturer without undue delay about that vulnerability. Furthermore, where the product with digital elements presents a significant cybersecurity risk, distributors shall immediately inform the market surveillance authorities of the Member States in which they have made the product with digital elements available on the market to that effect, giving details, in particular, of the non-compliance and of any corrective measures taken.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art20-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 98,
        "source_pinpoint": 20,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art20-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "8a71e47c9e5cb9a704d626d72213421d32398d2d8a2ae8792f583507fec75022",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art20-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 20,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Distributors shall, further to a reasoned request from a market surveillance authority, provide all the information and documentation, in paper or electronic form, necessary to demonstrate the conformity of the product with digital elements and the processes put in place by its manufacturer with this Regulation in a language that can be easily understood by that authority. They shall cooperate with that authority, at its request, on any measures taken to eliminate the cybersecurity risks posed by a product with digital elements which they have made available on the market.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art20-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 99,
        "source_pinpoint": 20,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art20-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "4909acebddf9154be1b75f35c303b4d908c291c9a1b2de219cb8a0c97f84c949",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art20-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 20,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of distributors",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where the distributor of a product with digital elements becomes aware, on the basis of information in its possession, that the manufacturer of that product has ceased its operations and, as result, is not able to comply with the obligations laid down in this Regulation, the distributor shall inform, without undue delay, the relevant market surveillance authorities about this situation, as well as, by any means available and to the extent possible, the users of the products with digital elements placed on the market.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art20-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 100,
        "source_pinpoint": 20,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art20-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6a50c93459b74c6fc94d067a8003fa533d03a6806c0f36a5f0b7d067ac633552",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art21-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 21,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply to importers and distributors",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply to importers and distributors",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "An importer or distributor shall be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation and shall be subject to Articles 13 and 14, where that importer or distributor places a product with digital elements on the market under its name or trademark or carries out a substantial modification of a product with digital elements already placed on the market.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art21-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 101,
        "source_pinpoint": 21,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art21-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "34af4e4eca1e4c749837a54c9082cfc1c2d32844e538e1cdcf31ba507d2af232",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art22-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 22,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Other cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "A natural or legal person, other than the manufacturer, the importer or the distributor, that carries out a substantial modification of a product with digital elements and makes that product available on the market, shall be considered to be a manufacturer for the purposes of this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art22-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 102,
        "source_pinpoint": 22,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art22-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "d470f9a15241986948c511288907f616524028af3cad1da7c553ee110ad04275",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art22-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 22,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Other cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Other cases in which obligations of manufacturers apply",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The person referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article shall be subject to the obligations set out in Articles 13 and 14 for the part of the product with digital elements that is affected by the substantial modification or, if the substantial modification has an impact on the cybersecurity of the product with digital elements as a whole, for the entire product.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art22-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 103,
        "source_pinpoint": 22,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art22-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "aceae9527dc5f6707834704b6e881ee7e27e7e177b8c9201879559f66f52c9dc",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art23-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 23,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Identification of economic operators",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Identification of economic operators",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the name and address of any economic operator who has supplied them with a product with digital elements;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "where available, the name and address of any economic operator to whom they have supplied a product with digital elements."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Economic operators shall, on request, provide the market surveillance authorities with the following information: (a) the name and address of any economic operator who has supplied them with a product with digital elements; (b) where available, the name and address of any economic operator to whom they have supplied a product with digital elements.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art23-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 104,
        "source_pinpoint": 23,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art23-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "da96775d2b741f80f7f27d26aeec2b732a474863b9ab14bf1aac9a3e1cec5fef",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art23-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 23,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Identification of economic operators",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Identification of economic operators",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Economic operators shall be able to present the information referred to in paragraph 1 for 10 years after they have been supplied with the product with digital elements and for 10 years after they have supplied the product with digital elements.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art23-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 105,
        "source_pinpoint": 23,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art23-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6404da406be204e5339a7b350f72ef6f04c559b7da21f239f1a2c9f238bb9ccd",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art24-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 24,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of open-source software stewards",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of open-source software stewards",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Open-source software stewards shall put in place and document in a verifiable manner a cybersecurity policy to foster the development of a secure product with digital elements as well as an effective handling of vulnerabilities by the developers of that product. That policy shall also foster the voluntary reporting of vulnerabilities as laid down in Article 15 by the developers of that product and take into account the specific nature of the open-source software steward and the legal and organisational arrangements to which it is subject. That policy shall, in particular, include aspects related to documenting, addressing and remediating vulnerabilities and promote the sharing of information concerning discovered vulnerabilities within the open-source community.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art24-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 106,
        "source_pinpoint": 24,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art24-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "929b36f5f944f93472edd16e5a701bfbaf7a117af5edae01cf97fb8048b2b476",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art24-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 24,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of open-source software stewards",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of open-source software stewards",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Open-source software stewards shall cooperate with the market surveillance authorities, at their request, with a view to mitigating the cybersecurity risks posed by a product with digital elements qualifying as free and open-source software. Further to a reasoned request from a market surveillance authority, open-source software stewards shall provide that authority, in a language which can be easily understood by that authority, with the documentation referred to in paragraph 1, in paper or electronic form.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art24-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 107,
        "source_pinpoint": 24,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art24-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "5262923e0fcc3a03506ed5e7e3135f57ea6dcfcfda04288c5fd4c16b5fed359d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art24-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 24,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Obligations of open-source software stewards",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Obligations of open-source software stewards",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "The obligations laid down in Article 14(1) shall apply to open-source software stewards to the extent that they are involved in the development of the products with digital elements. The obligations laid down in Article 14(3) and (8) shall apply to open-source software stewards to the extent that severe incidents having an impact on the security of products with digital elements affect network and information systems provided by the open-source software stewards for the development of such products.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art24-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 108,
        "source_pinpoint": 24,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art24-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1aa617e5df1c2ced99a3bc8a0d20401f5c9496a6481b95f44eaab366ab5d4db4",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art25-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 25,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Security attestation of free and open-source software",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Security attestation of free and open-source software",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "In order to facilitate the due diligence obligation set out in Article 13(5), in particular as regards manufacturers that integrate free and open-source software components in their products with digital elements, the Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 61 to supplement this Regulation by establishing voluntary security attestation programmes allowing the developers or users of products with digital elements qualifying as free and open-source software as well as other third parties to assess the conformity of such products with all or certain essential cybersecurity requirements or other obligations laid down in this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art25-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 109,
        "source_pinpoint": 25,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art25-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "efa258dd8c7e6c17237c2b01ea5d3da643bf81f434f9989f5f005157c74b3b16",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art26-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 26,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Guidance",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Guidance",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "In order to facilitate implementation and ensure the consistency of such implementation, the Commission shall publish guidance to assist economic operators in applying this Regulation, with a particular focus on facilitating compliance by microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art26-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 110,
        "source_pinpoint": 26,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art26-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "78f9375ab132ba037b15ef67f8cde5daa5f239c72a644883d05451aff14e867d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art26-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 26,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Guidance",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Guidance",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the scope of this Regulation, with a particular focus on remote data processing solutions and free and open-source software;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "the application of support periods in relation to particular categories of products with digital elements;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "guidance targeted at manufacturers subject to this Regulation that are also subject to Union harmonisation legislation other than this Regulation or to other related Union legal acts;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(d)",
            "text": "the concept of substantial modification. The Commission shall also maintain an easy-to-access list of the delegated and implementing acts adopted pursuant to this Regulation."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "Where it intends to provide guidance as referred to in paragraph 1, the Commission shall address at least the following aspects: (a) the scope of this Regulation, with a particular focus on remote data processing solutions and free and open-source software; (b) the application of support periods in relation to particular categories of products with digital elements; (c) guidance targeted at manufacturers subject to this Regulation that are also subject to Union harmonisation legislation other than this Regulation or to other related Union legal acts; (d) the concept of substantial modification. The Commission shall also maintain an easy-to-access list of the delegated and implementing acts adopted pursuant to this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art26-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 111,
        "source_pinpoint": 26,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art26-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "0b50061d31ee55a2d1c3d221e48633ecab8edb6f735285e528396a98210aa5ed",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art26-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 26,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Guidance",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Guidance",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
