        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER II"
        ],
        "text": "When preparing the guidance pursuant to this Article, the Commission shall consult relevant stakeholders.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art26-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 112,
        "source_pinpoint": 26,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art26-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "cdb9bb0ff868baa9e0125daff57d1e0ab57c832aaafb17a48012fc9b5c58f375",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Products with digital elements and processes put in place by the manufacturer which are in conformity with harmonised standards or parts thereof, the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union, shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I covered by those standards or parts thereof. The Commission shall, in accordance with Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, request one or more European standardisation organisations to draft harmonised standards for the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I to this Regulation. When preparing standardisation requests for this Regulation, the Commission shall strive to take into account existing European and international standards for cybersecurity that are in place or under development in order to simplify the development of harmonised standards, in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 113,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "639f28b3b7721711132d4058b8110752857c21d3cf2554dccbd1edaf4412bbe0",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the Commission has requested, pursuant to Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, one or more European standardisation organisations to draft a harmonised standard for the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I and:"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(i)",
            "text": "the request has not been accepted;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(ii)",
            "text": "the harmonised standards addressing that request are not delivered within the deadline set in accordance with Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012; or"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(iii)",
            "text": "the harmonised standards do not comply with the request; and"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "no reference to harmonised standards covering the relevant essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I to this Regulation has been published in the Official Journal of the European Union in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 and no such reference is expected to be published within a reasonable period. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 62(2)."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission may adopt implementing acts establishing common specifications covering technical requirements that provide a means to comply with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I for products with digital elements that fall within the scope of this Regulation. Those implementing acts shall be adopted only where the following conditions are fulfilled: (a) the Commission has requested, pursuant to Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012, one or more European standardisation organisations to draft a harmonised standard for the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I and: (i) the request has not been accepted; (ii) the harmonised standards addressing that request are not delivered within the deadline set in accordance with Article 10(1) of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012; or (iii) the harmonised standards do not comply with the request; and (b) no reference to harmonised standards covering the relevant essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I to this Regulation has been published in the Official Journal of the European Union in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 and no such reference is expected to be published within a reasonable period. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 62(2).",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 114,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f35bbd0fc7a0e4a2b5c050a49478822257fb0fccd06f5a565ed884bde1ede217",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Before preparing the draft implementing act referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, the Commission shall inform the committee referred to in Article 22 of Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 that it considers that the conditions in paragraph 2 of this Article have been fulfilled.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 115,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "19f1b056ae12d34ca45cb169bbe4407519a17f6c1f95bcc7267f5496377f273e",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "When preparing the draft implementing act referred to in paragraph 2, the Commission shall take into account the views of relevant bodies and shall duly consult all relevant stakeholders.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 116,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "710e3c503509c502a79aff55d7081d2d4648b0d296f846074eb7a05f370ff4c8",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Products with digital elements and processes put in place by the manufacturer which are in conformity with the common specifications established by implementing acts referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, or parts thereof, shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I covered by those common specifications or parts thereof.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 117,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "8bfa9c9bfeed25e8f213bdb172a56f97f2c6364fe025a246a4c10e4c0ebdf18f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Where a harmonised standard is adopted by a European standardisation organisation and proposed to the Commission for the purpose of publishing its reference in the Official Journal of the European Union, the Commission shall assess the harmonised standard in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012. When a reference of a harmonised standard is published in the Official Journal of the European Union, the Commission shall repeal the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article, or parts thereof which cover the same essential cybersecurity requirements as those covered by that harmonised standard.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 118,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "0b62fff9c4a605e6655d7152972e767dc9128017d54ebd2f6154d866b3df879d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para7",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "7",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Where a Member State considers that a common specification does not entirely satisfy the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I, it shall inform the Commission thereof by submitting a detailed explanation. The Commission shall assess that detailed explanation and may, if appropriate, amend the implementing act establishing the common specification in question.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para7",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 119,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para7"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6144966168b1fb0e6220c11186cd59adeece188d7201503bb617d9cf2eb9fdd1",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para8",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "8",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Products with digital elements and processes put in place by the manufacturer for which an EU statement of conformity or certificate has been issued under a European cybersecurity certification scheme adopted pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I in so far as the EU statement of conformity or European cybersecurity certificate, or parts thereof, cover those requirements.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para8",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 120,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para8"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f8a5ab4c7d5da564045fb3e4e0a8866d71df1fbac4e2b6bfd551e268434d4584",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art27-Para9",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 27,
        "paragraph_number": "9",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 61 of this Regulation to supplement this Regulation by specifying the European cybersecurity certification schemes adopted pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 that can be used to demonstrate conformity of products with digital elements with the essential cybersecurity requirements or parts thereof as set out in Annex I to this Regulation. Furthermore, the issuance of a European cybersecurity certificate issued under such schemes, at least at assurance level ‘substantial’, eliminates the obligation of a manufacturer to carry out a third-party conformity assessment for the corresponding requirements, as set out in Article 32(2), points (a) and (b), and Article 32(3), points (a) and (b), of this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art27-Para9",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 121,
        "source_pinpoint": 27,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art27-Para9"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "b1e875529e9db6ab4e186735f7dfadcb60a55983d90d12cd250fd95f123bba83",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art28-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 28,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The EU declaration of conformity shall be drawn up by manufacturers in accordance with Article 13(12) and state that the fulfilment of the applicable essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I has been demonstrated.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art28-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 122,
        "source_pinpoint": 28,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art28-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "0edac60a3814ce9cff08513f274a4c1a11c193fecae884a4ed5a7e2351fe88e6",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art28-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 28,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The EU declaration of conformity shall have the model structure set out in Annex V and shall contain the elements specified in the relevant conformity assessment procedures set out in Annex VIII. Such a declaration shall be updated as appropriate. It shall be made available in the languages required by the Member State in which the product with digital elements is placed on the market or made available on the market. The simplified EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 13(20) shall have the model structure set out in Annex VI. It shall be made available in the languages required by the Member State in which the product with digital elements is placed on the market or made available on the market.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art28-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 123,
        "source_pinpoint": 28,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art28-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "4fc714911d9e623a0b48231508a0f29ad2975b6a9f9a4f44be7f0b492c5ec1d0",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art28-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 28,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Where a product with digital elements is subject to more than one Union legal act requiring an EU declaration of conformity, a single EU declaration of conformity shall be drawn up in respect of all such Union legal acts. That declaration shall contain the identification of the Union legal acts concerned, including their publication references.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art28-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 124,
        "source_pinpoint": 28,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art28-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "98c5d7cb7859d0d05ea517b254fe1f9649feb73aea7b164ad41a0c42be242479",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art28-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 28,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "By drawing up the EU declaration of conformity, the manufacturer shall assume responsibility for the compliance of the product with digital elements.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art28-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 125,
        "source_pinpoint": 28,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art28-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "918c0f0f04dab552b2029dd91bf31991e4f5307d506e33f064074474a0a9b3c2",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art28-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 28,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_heading": "EU declaration of conformity",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 61 to supplement this Regulation by adding elements to the minimum content of the EU declaration of conformity set out in Annex V to take account of technological developments.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art28-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 126,
        "source_pinpoint": 28,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art28-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "b63c5fb62eb9e3b4d93c3a95e203096ec6447c88e355f3520b08803e946a51dc",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art29-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 29,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "General principles of the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_heading": "General principles of the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The CE marking shall be subject to the general principles set out in Article 30 of Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art29-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 127,
        "source_pinpoint": 29,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art29-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "ea342989e6977e6bb8ae1a31904c989ef18a9991e984bee5e0bfe15246b09c52",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art30-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 30,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The CE marking shall be affixed visibly, legibly and indelibly to the product with digital elements. Where that is not possible or not warranted on account of the nature of the product with digital elements, it shall be affixed to the packaging and to the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 28 accompanying the product with digital elements. For products with digital elements which are in the form of software, the CE marking shall be affixed either to the EU declaration of conformity referred to in Article 28 or on the website accompanying the software product. In the latter case, the relevant section of the website shall be easily and directly accessible to consumers.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art30-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 128,
        "source_pinpoint": 30,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art30-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "4b4ce455570b267f9363a0a9362e5394f6b1be1dd16d9352bd575065fda21bf7",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art30-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 30,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "On account of the nature of the product with digital elements, the height of the CE marking affixed to the product with digital elements may be lower than 5 mm, provided that it remains visible and legible.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art30-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 129,
        "source_pinpoint": 30,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art30-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "cde901cb7667624dbcc2e3da3f3971b7f615a93aea623513c495f08b9cb1fd2b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art30-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 30,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The CE marking shall be affixed before the product with digital elements is placed on the market. It may be followed by a pictogram or any other mark indicating a special cybersecurity risk or use set out in the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 6.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art30-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",

      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art30-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 30,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body, where that body is involved in the conformity assessment procedure based on full quality assurance (based on module H) referred to in Article 32. The identification number of the notified body shall be affixed by the body itself or, under its instructions, by the manufacturer or the manufacturer’s authorised representative.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art30-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 131,
        "source_pinpoint": 30,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art30-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1ea6ea5b28c1837a8be9bc3966959c3aacea1254b0243f42a793e6211f97779e",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art30-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 30,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall build upon existing mechanisms to ensure correct application of the regime governing the CE marking and shall take appropriate action in the event of improper use of that marking. Where the product with digital elements is subject to Union harmonisation legislation, other than this Regulation, which also provides for the affixing of the CE marking, the CE marking shall indicate that the product also fulfils the requirements set out in such other Union harmonisation legislation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art30-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 132,
        "source_pinpoint": 30,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art30-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "58dcf644ddea6d458d79d06783a95abedbc5dc955866b23f929e8c9466f0aecb",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art30-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 30,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Rules and conditions for affixing the CE marking",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission may, by means of implementing acts, lay down technical specifications for labels, pictograms or any other marks related to the security of the products with digital elements, their support periods and mechanisms to promote their use and to increase public awareness about the security of products with digital elements. When preparing the draft implementing acts, the Commission shall consult relevant stakeholders, and, if it has already been established pursuant to Article 52(15), ADCO. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 62(2).",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art30-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 133,
        "source_pinpoint": 30,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art30-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "951fee7288f714359d0d3991ef5fa416997f90c2e471d3c52806009b3a5b140c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art31-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 31,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The technical documentation shall contain all relevant data or details of the means used by the manufacturer to ensure that the product with digital elements and the processes put in place by the manufacturer comply with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I. It shall at least contain the elements set out in Annex VII.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art31-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 134,
        "source_pinpoint": 31,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art31-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "10b2bfeff39f7cfb75fdb4dc6502867b9f0ce02d93f3cddb3b3af845d2323189",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art31-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 31,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The technical documentation shall be drawn up before the product with digital elements is placed on the market and shall be continuously updated, where appropriate, at least during the support period.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art31-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 135,
        "source_pinpoint": 31,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art31-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "ef2ddce9f70c4938789ddf9b83ec8300a65fc18c729511274000a4327f9e86b5",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art31-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 31,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "For products with digital elements as referred to in Article 12, which are also subject to other Union legal acts which provide for technical documentation, a single set of technical documentation shall be drawn up containing the information referred to in Annex VII and the information required by those Union legal acts.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art31-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 136,
        "source_pinpoint": 31,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art31-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "3346ec4b10de06d711d7b8ee1bd7d536c82d4489de6914c06f0c0776259e726c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art31-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 31,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The technical documentation and correspondence relating to any conformity assessment procedure shall be drawn up in an official language of the Member State in which the notified body is established or in a language acceptable to that body.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art31-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 137,
        "source_pinpoint": 31,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art31-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "47feb5580be979dcf0740cb526d3f0ccdda5a7a4b26b3d321e7089fce88c8e68",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art31-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 31,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Technical documentation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 61 to supplement this Regulation by adding elements to be included in the technical documentation set out in Annex VII to take account of technological developments, as well as developments encountered in the implementation process of this Regulation. To that end, the Commission shall strive to ensure that the administrative burden on microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises is proportionate.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art31-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 138,
        "source_pinpoint": 31,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art31-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "a48257435e938580a0d02ca7c76ddcc0c6aa96517c196196fc3da3c0ddc67fbc",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art32-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 32,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the internal control procedure (based on module A) set out in Annex VIII;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "the EU-type examination procedure (based on module B) set out in Annex VIII followed by conformity to EU-type based on internal production control (based on module C) set out in Annex VIII;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "a conformity assessment based on full quality assurance (based on module H) set out in Annex VIII; or"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(d)",
            "text": "where available and applicable, a European cybersecurity certification scheme pursuant to Article 27(9)."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The manufacturer shall perform a conformity assessment of the product with digital elements and the processes put in place by the manufacturer to determine whether the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I are met. The manufacturer shall demonstrate conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements by using any of the following procedures: (a) the internal control procedure (based on module A) set out in Annex VIII; (b) the EU-type examination procedure (based on module B) set out in Annex VIII followed by conformity to EU-type based on internal production control (based on module C) set out in Annex VIII; (c) a conformity assessment based on full quality assurance (based on module H) set out in Annex VIII; or (d) where available and applicable, a European cybersecurity certification scheme pursuant to Article 27(9).",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art32-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 139,
        "source_pinpoint": 32,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art32-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1e53f472b4d6d1ad817670e243ed07af485129a071d31e6d98c33e05aa3f28d4",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art32-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 32,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the EU-type examination procedure (based on module B) set out in Annex VIII followed by conformity to EU-type based on internal production control (based on module C) set out in Annex VIII; or"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "a conformity assessment based on full quality assurance (based on module H) set out in Annex VIII."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Where, in assessing the compliance of an important product with digital elements that falls under class I as set out in Annex III and the processes put in place by its manufacturer with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I, the manufacturer has not applied or has applied only in part harmonised standards, common specifications or European cybersecurity certification schemes at assurance level at least ‘substantial’ as referred to in Article 27, or where such harmonised standards, common specifications or European cybersecurity certification schemes do not exist, the product with digital elements concerned and the processes put in place by the manufacturer shall be submitted with regard to those essential cybersecurity requirements to either of the following procedures: (a) the EU-type examination procedure (based on module B) set out in Annex VIII followed by conformity to EU-type based on internal production control (based on module C) set out in Annex VIII; or (b) a conformity assessment based on full quality assurance (based on module H) set out in Annex VIII.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art32-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 140,
        "source_pinpoint": 32,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art32-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "3f85f9b267d759adfbdf2fac242117b407486bad5362296878eeb3656aa9114c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art32-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 32,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "EU-type examination procedure (based on module B) set out in Annex VIII followed by conformity to EU-type based on internal production control (based on module C) set out in Annex VIII;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "a conformity assessment based on full quality assurance (based on module H) set out in Annex VIII; or"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "where available and applicable, a European cybersecurity certification scheme pursuant to Article 27(9) of this Regulation at assurance level at least ‘substantial’ pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Where the product is an important product with digital elements that falls under class II as set out in Annex III, the manufacturer shall demonstrate conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I by using any of the following procedures: (a) EU-type examination procedure (based on module B) set out in Annex VIII followed by conformity to EU-type based on internal production control (based on module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) a conformity assessment based on full quality assurance (based on module H) set out in Annex VIII; or (c) where available and applicable, a European cybersecurity certification scheme pursuant to Article 27(9) of this Regulation at assurance level at least ‘substantial’ pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art32-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 141,
        "source_pinpoint": 32,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art32-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "718fd201cf957a88787bd2dd3fd0a21b56c101302f07f7331d2674b65d57c421",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art32-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 32,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "a European cybersecurity certification scheme in accordance with Article 8(1); or"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "where the conditions in Article 8(1) are not met, any of the procedures referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Critical products with digital elements listed in Annex IV shall demonstrate conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I by using one of the following procedures: (a) a European cybersecurity certification scheme in accordance with Article 8(1); or (b) where the conditions in Article 8(1) are not met, any of the procedures referred to in paragraph 3 of this Article.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art32-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 142,
        "source_pinpoint": 32,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art32-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "67103a69b0b4a1c1061f70f69ec33f564f693138d35feee1a5bcea61974a7747",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art32-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 32,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Manufacturers of products with digital elements qualifying as free and open-source software, which fall under the categories set out in Annex III, shall be able to demonstrate conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I by using one of the procedures referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article, provided that the technical documentation referred to in Article 31 is made available to the public at the time of the placing on the market of those products.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art32-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 143,
        "source_pinpoint": 32,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art32-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "03b0750b33e9e753dc13304e451301e137bdd6835b0ea034fa1297333e49609a",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art32-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 32,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Conformity assessment procedures for products with digital elements",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The specific interests and needs of microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups, shall be taken into account when setting the fees for conformity assessment procedures and those fees shall be reduced proportionately to their specific interests and needs.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art32-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 144,
        "source_pinpoint": 32,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art32-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "9195b1e0d01266f50c1f14cbbc2c828ef6840bd93f7410d4713925859a4a6c20",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art33-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 33,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "organise specific awareness-raising and training activities about the application of this Regulation;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "establish a dedicated channel for communication with microenterprises and small enterprises and, as appropriate, local public authorities to provide advice and respond to queries about the implementation of this Regulation;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "support testing and conformity assessment activities, including where relevant with the support of the European Cybersecurity Competence Centre."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall, where appropriate, undertake the following actions, tailored to the needs of microenterprises and small enterprises: (a) organise specific awareness-raising and training activities about the application of this Regulation; (b) establish a dedicated channel for communication with microenterprises and small enterprises and, as appropriate, local public authorities to provide advice and respond to queries about the implementation of this Regulation; (c) support testing and conformity assessment activities, including where relevant with the support of the European Cybersecurity Competence Centre.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art33-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 145,
        "source_pinpoint": 33,
        "source_locator": {

          "producer_id": "article-Art33-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [

        ],

        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art33-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 33,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Member States may, where appropriate, establish cyber resilience regulatory sandboxes. Such regulatory sandboxes shall provide for controlled testing environments for innovative products with digital elements to facilitate their development, design, validation and testing for the purpose of complying with this Regulation for a limited period of time before the placing on the market. The Commission and, where appropriate, ENISA, may provide technical support, advice and tools for the establishment and operation of regulatory sandboxes. The regulatory sandboxes shall be set up under the direct supervision, guidance and support by the market surveillance authorities. Member States shall inform the Commission and the other market surveillance authorities of the establishment of a regulatory sandbox through ADCO. The regulatory sandboxes shall not affect the supervisory and corrective powers of the competent authorities. Member States shall ensure open, fair, and transparent access to regulatory sandboxes, and in particular facilitate access by microenterprises and small enterprises, including start-ups.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art33-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 146,
        "source_pinpoint": 33,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art33-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "d48da1f2984721a0023e188a947c3617a269df949a5545a4d4f4b1e621ffad00",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art33-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 33,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "In accordance with Article 26, the Commission shall provide guidance for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises in relation to the implementation of this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art33-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 147,
        "source_pinpoint": 33,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art33-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "64a3f4a4bdb3ffe7e51ef11880242324b0ee5a04de3ad0d8a7e2162b74e10f1c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art33-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 33,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall advertise available financial support in the regulatory framework of existing Union programmes, in particular in order to ease the financial burden on microenterprises and small enterprises.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art33-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 148,
        "source_pinpoint": 33,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art33-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "7c93a68fae6c458e584c2c1bcdc870cfd2f966ed28b05e931eb10c8571237375",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art33-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 33,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Support measures for microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, including start-ups",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Microenterprises and small enterprises may provide all elements of the technical documentation specified in Annex VII by using a simplified format. For that purpose, the Commission shall, by means of implementing acts, specify the simplified technical documentation form targeted at the needs of microenterprises and small enterprises, including how the elements set out in Annex VII are to be provided. Where a microenterprise or small enterprise opts to provide the information set out in Annex VII in a simplified manner, it shall use the form referred to in this paragraph. Notified bodies shall accept that form for the purposes of conformity assessment. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 62(2).",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art33-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 149,
        "source_pinpoint": 33,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art33-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "2963b98e61a13f9b98b6916b2ec9c1c9e99d2485c936aa80a90d28e97bfc2e9d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art34-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 34,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Mutual recognition agreements",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Mutual recognition agreements",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER III"
        ],
        "text": "Taking into account the level of technical development and the approach on conformity assessment of a third country, the Union may conclude Mutual Recognition Agreements with third countries, in accordance with Article 218 TFEU, in order to promote and facilitate international trade.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art34-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 150,
        "source_pinpoint": 34,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art34-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "04d9eec62b0da9c248b35667a6b2ff57ed6b1413447760d620d5c947bc4717db",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art35-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 35,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Notification",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall notify the Commission and the other Member States of bodies authorised to carry out conformity assessments in accordance with this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art35-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 151,
        "source_pinpoint": 35,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art35-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "bbd87b49e472fdf43c6c4102386c5e204f6bca2021dddb300f48d03f240c0d5a",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art35-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 35,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Notification",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall strive to ensure, by 11 December 2026 that there is a sufficient number of notified bodies in the Union to carry out conformity assessments, in order to avoid bottlenecks and hindrances to market entry.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art35-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 152,
        "source_pinpoint": 35,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art35-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "7e0a1c0d1f44380d96fc6cab0dc78c3c6e8e9508b6f505f05c8e4b4d8819c85b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art36-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 36,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Each Member State shall designate a notifying authority that shall be responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment, designation and notification of conformity assessment bodies and their monitoring, including compliance with Article 41.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art36-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 153,
        "source_pinpoint": 36,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art36-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "813330e345ac9bd219a4cb5ae1355845df1754074e17580a4a0bf0552ffbf9ac",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art36-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 36,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Member States may decide that the assessment and monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 shall be carried out by a national accreditation body within the meaning of and in accordance with Regulation (EC) No 765/2008.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art36-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 154,
        "source_pinpoint": 36,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art36-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1617de7dc5a096d5d02d8a1b553c0767b382218c0899ad56161a261ad5396fdf",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art36-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 36,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where the notifying authority delegates or otherwise entrusts the assessment, notification or monitoring referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article to a body which is not a governmental entity, that body shall be a legal entity and shall comply mutatis mutandis with Article 37. In addition, it shall have arrangements in place to cover liabilities arising from its activities.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art36-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 155,
        "source_pinpoint": 36,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art36-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "e1ac8d4a0fe4f5f2d3e2c77cd25c94a44e5e212fffae0f1de29d130b505ca094",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art36-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 36,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The notifying authority shall take full responsibility for the tasks performed by the body referred to in paragraph 3.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art36-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 156,
        "source_pinpoint": 36,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art36-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "cb347d99446d20c376e37057c1c4c9dfcca90a1c64d2c6b3433c3020d09eab03",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art37-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 37,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A notifying authority shall be established in such a way that no conflict of interest with conformity assessment bodies occurs.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art37-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 157,
        "source_pinpoint": 37,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art37-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "4fb116401dcfe7d4033e32eddfdcfa0ef271f408e4eabe7bed11cc6466f418a2",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art37-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 37,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A notifying authority shall be organised and shall function so as to safeguard the objectivity and impartiality of its activities.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art37-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 158,
        "source_pinpoint": 37,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art37-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "62a28188b27673b6738686df0d96198367146eef4cff9c57c843ec0060d6f1ad",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art37-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 37,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A notifying authority shall be organised in such a way that each decision relating to notification of a conformity assessment body is taken by competent persons different from those who carried out the assessment.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art37-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 159,
        "source_pinpoint": 37,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art37-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "9a331a674afacb86bd5511b8b9e6ad02b0954b6098a4b20d1cb05380f0e732ed",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art37-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 37,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A notifying authority shall not offer or provide any activities that conformity assessment bodies perform or consultancy services on commercial or competitive basis.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art37-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 160,
        "source_pinpoint": 37,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art37-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "ca3cedb13c7044444e67cd48727dc21143fc3e48d4241b29c14c022893337cca",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art37-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 37,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A notifying authority shall safeguard the confidentiality of the information it obtains.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art37-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 161,
        "source_pinpoint": 37,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art37-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "923850a01aa43cd74cc8b254f22b05941970ea035ff033488de81ff3d5217df5",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art37-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 37,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A notifying authority shall have a sufficient number of competent personnel at its disposal for the proper performance of its tasks.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art37-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 162,
        "source_pinpoint": 37,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art37-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "7c300d5851e2a9f69385402b8255c163671a06ac03cae0482a00860505dfa7ea",
