        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art38-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 38,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Information obligation on notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Information obligation on notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall inform the Commission of their procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies and the monitoring of notified bodies, and of any changes thereto.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art38-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 163,
        "source_pinpoint": 38,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art38-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "d6de72eed6943f6fc4c0231b5fabdadccea8388b27a380ae5daca94b82086156",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art38-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 38,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Information obligation on notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Information obligation on notifying authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall make the information referred to in paragraph 1 publicly available.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art38-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 164,
        "source_pinpoint": 38,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art38-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "03a75e5cb7c5d46081902b5aa7e00004dbae9cc9a5ea8150bd57e5e72bc5880e",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "For the purposes of notification, a conformity assessment body shall meet the requirements laid down in paragraphs 2 to 12.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 165,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "233cf08a5260b71bf77b06186c47e17ffd620238b2895d53de74816a93657e76",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A conformity assessment body shall be established under national law and have legal personality.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 166,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "c998fc7f36b76cf301781a9f8974e3b6d6fb34f8518b64f1a4844d241450fbc9",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A conformity assessment body shall be a third-party body independent of the organisation or the product with digital elements it assesses. A body belonging to a business association or professional federation representing undertakings involved in the design, development, production, provision, assembly, use or maintenance of products with digital elements which it assesses, may, on condition that its independence and the absence of any conflict of interest are demonstrated, be considered to be such a third-party body.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 167,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "072b98f8a273830faeb3af1e96c70cd84204c8962d886a63e23c07d3301575d7",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A conformity assessment body, its top level management and the personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks shall not be the designer, developer, manufacturer, supplier, importer, distributor, installer, purchaser, owner, user or maintainer of the products with digital elements which they assess, nor the authorised representative of any of those parties. This shall not preclude the use of assessed products that are necessary for the operations of the conformity assessment body or the use of such products for personal purposes. A conformity assessment body, its top level management and the personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks shall not be directly involved in the design, development, production, import, distribution, the marketing, installation, use or maintenance of the products with digital elements which they assess, or represent the parties engaged in those activities. They shall not engage in any activity that may conflict with their independence of judgement or integrity in relation to conformity assessment activities for which they are notified. This shall in particular apply to consultancy services. Conformity assessment bodies shall ensure that the activities of their subsidiaries or subcontractors do not affect the confidentiality, objectivity or impartiality of their conformity assessment activities.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 168,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "64697189cdcb1638dbd7b7ea23c7b5d3403555381ed0bb35c17bbb642ba5e0a5",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Conformity assessment bodies and their personnel shall carry out the conformity assessment activities with the highest degree of professional integrity and the requisite technical competence in the specific field and shall be free from all pressures and inducements, particularly financial, which might influence their judgement or the results of their conformity assessment activities, especially as regards persons or groups of persons with an interest in the results of those activities.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 169,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "2e4109760c9495aa0b0097bcb029b780ad531cabb91a13c8fee87a6907168835",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "personnel with technical knowledge and sufficient and appropriate experience to perform the conformity assessment tasks;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "descriptions of procedures in accordance with which conformity assessment is to be carried out, ensuring the transparency of and ability to reproduce those procedures. It shall have appropriate policies and procedures in place that distinguish between tasks it carries out as a notified body and other activities;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "procedures for the performance of activities which take due account of the size of an undertaking, the sector in which it operates, its structure, the degree of complexity of the product technology in question and the mass or serial nature of the production process. A conformity assessment body shall have the means necessary to perform the technical and administrative tasks connected with the conformity assessment activities in an appropriate manner and shall have access to all necessary equipment or facilities."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A conformity assessment body shall be capable of carrying out all the conformity assessment tasks referred to in Annex VIII and in relation to which it has been notified, regardless of whether those tasks are carried out by the conformity assessment body itself or on its behalf and under its responsibility. At all times and for each conformity assessment procedure and each kind or category of products with digital elements in relation to which it has been notified, a conformity assessment body shall have at its disposal the necessary: (a) personnel with technical knowledge and sufficient and appropriate experience to perform the conformity assessment tasks; (b) descriptions of procedures in accordance with which conformity assessment is to be carried out, ensuring the transparency of and ability to reproduce those procedures. It shall have appropriate policies and procedures in place that distinguish between tasks it carries out as a notified body and other activities; (c) procedures for the performance of activities which take due account of the size of an undertaking, the sector in which it operates, its structure, the degree of complexity of the product technology in question and the mass or serial nature of the production process. A conformity assessment body shall have the means necessary to perform the technical and administrative tasks connected with the conformity assessment activities in an appropriate manner and shall have access to all necessary equipment or facilities.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 170,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "d8a05d552ecc5b0139f647c9cef65a0ee192c4efa0c301c497d24a7ca89838f0",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para7",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "7",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "sound technical and vocational training covering all the conformity assessment activities in relation to which the conformity assessment body has been notified;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "satisfactory knowledge of the requirements of the assessments they carry out and adequate authority to carry out those assessments;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "appropriate knowledge and understanding of the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I, of the applicable harmonised standards and common specifications, and of the relevant provisions of Union harmonisation legislation and implementing acts;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(d)",
            "text": "the ability to draw up certificates, records and reports demonstrating that assessments have been carried out."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The personnel responsible for carrying out conformity assessment activities shall have the following: (a) sound technical and vocational training covering all the conformity assessment activities in relation to which the conformity assessment body has been notified; (b) satisfactory knowledge of the requirements of the assessments they carry out and adequate authority to carry out those assessments; (c) appropriate knowledge and understanding of the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I, of the applicable harmonised standards and common specifications, and of the relevant provisions of Union harmonisation legislation and implementing acts; (d) the ability to draw up certificates, records and reports demonstrating that assessments have been carried out.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para7",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 171,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para7"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "94ede2eb9365cf54019fc651d2af55d80c74bfb70915531cf9f837018302d970",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para8",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "8",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The impartiality of the conformity assessment bodies, their top level management and of the assessment personnel shall be guaranteed. The remuneration of the top level management and assessment personnel of a conformity assessment body shall not depend on the number of assessments carried out or on the results of those assessments.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para8",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 172,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para8"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "172b76e40f86ca219797ba9a9dd241a1cd5248aa48854505a5bd287602b246c8",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para9",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "9",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Conformity assessment bodies shall take out liability insurance unless liability is assumed by their Member State in accordance with national law, or the Member State itself is directly responsible for the conformity assessment.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para9",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 173,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para9"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "89e9629f48f7dad1165e7274b94a48efa25a0f49653cda5c1820a1c8de57a339",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para10",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "10",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The personnel of a conformity assessment body shall observe professional secrecy with regard to all information obtained in carrying out their tasks under Annex VIII or any provision of national law giving effect to it, except in relation to the market surveillance authorities of the Member State in which its activities are carried out. Proprietary rights shall be protected. The conformity assessment body shall have documented procedures ensuring compliance with this paragraph.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para10",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 174,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para10"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "bcd3023da2ca9df12e1c969a7adf5c9b838c1ef2c7f7dbde1aa1de8f2ce2595f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para11",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "11",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Conformity assessment bodies shall participate in, or ensure that their assessment personnel are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities and the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 51 and apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of that group.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para11",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 175,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para11"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "178eeb000dd5ef8ca8cbdc54f9eaa13a494cc97bad59725f2665aa3996bead40",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art39-Para12",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 39,
        "paragraph_number": "12",
        "article_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Requirements relating to notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Conformity assessment bodies shall operate in accordance with a set of consistent, fair, proportionate and reasonable terms and conditions, while avoiding unnecessary burden for economic operators, in particular taking into account the interests of microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises in relation to fees.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art39-Para12",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 176,
        "source_pinpoint": 39,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art39-Para12"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "2aa4f9badd5ab5700f6951441ec9b4220fb0649b24d355c6775abec94d606044",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art40-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 40,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Presumption of conformity of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Presumption of conformity of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where a conformity assessment body demonstrates its conformity with the criteria laid down in the relevant harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union it shall be presumed to comply with the requirements set out in Article 39 in so far as the applicable harmonised standards cover those requirements.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art40-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 177,
        "source_pinpoint": 40,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art40-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "40343f57d2022a375870b3bceaaf8b2d931f6f5a099d7f05e2df23b3e69e54d1",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art41-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 41,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where a notified body subcontracts specific tasks connected with conformity assessment or has recourse to a subsidiary, it shall ensure that the subcontractor or the subsidiary meets the requirements set out in Article 39 and shall inform the notifying authority accordingly.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art41-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 178,
        "source_pinpoint": 41,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art41-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "b5cdb410a450907b8ce078d101d90a3020785d1cabc730da96d76c9dca3551a1",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art41-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 41,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Notified bodies shall take full responsibility for the tasks performed by subcontractors or subsidiaries wherever they are established.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art41-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 179,
        "source_pinpoint": 41,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art41-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "de0a75cb1cc22be93dfa95f84a2441782cca0b77926683bea48882f0b5c7743c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art41-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 41,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Activities may be subcontracted or carried out by a subsidiary only with the agreement of the manufacturer.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art41-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 180,
        "source_pinpoint": 41,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art41-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "8f693b08a425bb827f9582d942196d1c5e41c8d5277b7980dbc0b93659dd1ff4",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art41-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 41,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Subsidiaries of and subcontracting by notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Notified bodies shall keep at the disposal of the notifying authority the relevant documents concerning the assessment of the qualifications of the subcontractor or the subsidiary and the work carried out by them under this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art41-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 181,
        "source_pinpoint": 41,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art41-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "0a5139547c6035dbcb360b6ff8331025096f591020f899fdea1d22f59f71631f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art42-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 42,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Application for notification",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Application for notification",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "A conformity assessment body shall submit an application for notification to the notifying authority of the Member State in which it is established.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art42-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 182,
        "source_pinpoint": 42,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art42-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "4952b91834ed02fe51b5ec7e714ae5e62a42239e5f145d2875c6560b17d89c5d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art42-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 42,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Application for notification",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Application for notification",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "That application shall be accompanied by a description of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment procedure or procedures and the product or products with digital elements for which that body claims to be competent, as well as, where applicable, by an accreditation certificate issued by a national accreditation body attesting that the conformity assessment body fulfils the requirements laid down in Article 39.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art42-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 183,
        "source_pinpoint": 42,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art42-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "97e949cd1d7b77c6a7825e398898b40dd9a7f3a09f9dea210561a1298b3ff3e4",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art42-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 42,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Application for notification",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Application for notification",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where the conformity assessment body concerned cannot provide an accreditation certificate, it shall provide the notifying authority with all the documentary evidence necessary for the verification, recognition and regular monitoring of its compliance with the requirements laid down in Article 39.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art42-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 184,
        "source_pinpoint": 42,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art42-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "57453b39727a4322209742d66c9042c46726fcc3d71fdb47835e53023e8aa3f1",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art43-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 43,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Notifying authorities shall notify only conformity assessment bodies which have satisfied the requirements laid down in Article 39.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art43-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 185,
        "source_pinpoint": 43,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art43-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "7550f798a2e467804541896e6ee4caf0d98a75ffa3516eb2843c1a584d2262e3",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art43-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 43,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The notifying authority shall notify the Commission and the other Member States using the New Approach Notified and Designated Organisations information system developed and managed by the Commission.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art43-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 186,
        "source_pinpoint": 43,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art43-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f71cc9fce59d279affba89e93a0ac64fe941ada34aa7cc727e23270bfbe558c1",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art43-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 43,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The notification shall include full details of the conformity assessment activities, the conformity assessment module or modules and product or products with digital elements concerned and the relevant attestation of competence.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art43-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 187,
        "source_pinpoint": 43,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art43-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1545bd9b2ec08fa5b5a66119d332f79b5c189f5af3795fae523e26ecc426358c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art43-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 43,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where a notification is not based on an accreditation certificate as referred to in Article 42(2), the notifying authority shall provide the Commission and the other Member States with documentary evidence which attests to the conformity assessment body’s competence and the arrangements in place to ensure that that body will be monitored regularly and will continue to satisfy the requirements laid down in Article 39.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art43-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 188,
        "source_pinpoint": 43,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art43-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "dc9baff4d851ae99339958e5619a65eeb75933639b163e4a128bb67128542069",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art43-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 43,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The body concerned may perform the activities of a notified body only where no objections are raised by the Commission or the other Member States within two weeks of a notification where an accreditation certificate is used or within two months of a notification where accreditation is not used. Only such a body shall be considered to be a notified body for the purposes of this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art43-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 189,
        "source_pinpoint": 43,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art43-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "43efa3cbae80e4cf7f3352433d7ef4789f816a8b710ebf2ea772a41b21361a6b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art43-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 43,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Notification procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission and the other Member States shall be notified of any subsequent relevant changes to the notification.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art43-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 190,
        "source_pinpoint": 43,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art43-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f2d506617ed5d1ba5ab57d4dc857ed29799e6567551b463ae1216e8d7aa36a92",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art44-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 44,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Identification numbers and lists of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Identification numbers and lists of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall assign an identification number to a notified body. It shall assign a single such number even where the body is notified under several Union legal acts.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art44-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 191,
        "source_pinpoint": 44,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art44-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "b97fe6657e57ca1ef9fde1408db1ccc061c69968ed64bf2517b9ca6124028fc8",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art44-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 44,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Identification numbers and lists of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Identification numbers and lists of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall make publicly available the list of the bodies notified under this Regulation, including the identification numbers that have been allocated to them and the activities for which they have been notified. The Commission shall ensure that that list is kept up to date.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art44-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 192,
        "source_pinpoint": 44,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art44-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "ac9616c6207c173dc595e9a8a326781655f69b055ee4e51a14e1b9ccb72d48a9",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art45-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 45,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Changes to notifications",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Changes to notifications",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where a notifying authority has ascertained or has been informed that a notified body no longer meets the requirements laid down in Article 39, or that it is failing to fulfil its obligations, the notifying authority shall restrict, suspend or withdraw notification as appropriate, depending on the seriousness of the failure to meet those requirements or fulfil those obligations. It shall immediately inform the Commission and the other Member States accordingly.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art45-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 193,
        "source_pinpoint": 45,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art45-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "5d84e1d059c7171d2cca3fa5c54930dda88155cb06ca15008cdcbf3bf59eae90",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art45-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 45,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Changes to notifications",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Changes to notifications",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "In the event of restriction, suspension or withdrawal of notification, or where the notified body has ceased its activity, the notifying Member State shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of that body are either processed by another notified body or kept available for the responsible notifying and market surveillance authorities at their request.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art45-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 194,
        "source_pinpoint": 45,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art45-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "0bd48cf51b2315b27b951d7b03bcff22ce23e3b6ff98fe1a7a9fa1b44696d80a",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art46-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 46,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall investigate all cases where it doubts, or where doubt is brought to its attention regarding, the competence of a notified body to meet, or the continued fulfilment by a notified body of, the requirements and responsibilities to which it is subject.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art46-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 195,
        "source_pinpoint": 46,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art46-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "8449d75fd82dfe1119c25494ca287313c07084d6483fb56b3930264a32f35926",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art46-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 46,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The notifying Member State shall provide the Commission, on request, with all information relating to the basis for the notification or the maintenance of the competence of the body concerned.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art46-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 196,
        "source_pinpoint": 46,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art46-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1bc11818267d638f33355f2eb474c6222f1266f3e59c2dfbb6a001cd57789401",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art46-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 46,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall ensure that all sensitive information obtained in the course of its investigations is treated confidentially.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art46-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 197,
        "source_pinpoint": 46,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art46-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "24792836d86d88de4e82913deb1971443644a150cf7b23cdc6970d7e243595f1",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art46-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 46,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Challenge of the competence of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where the Commission ascertains that a notified body does not meet or no longer meets the requirements for its notification, it shall inform the notifying Member State accordingly and request it to take the necessary corrective measures, including de-notification if necessary.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art46-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 198,
        "source_pinpoint": 46,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art46-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "aaa01d0c5fa69e88b1cd6d7e46f279d4c7dfce0411824466b170a8418820921d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art47-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 47,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Notified bodies shall carry out conformity assessments in accordance with the conformity assessment procedures provided for in Article 32 and Annex VIII.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art47-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 199,
        "source_pinpoint": 47,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art47-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "945616db3c13168510e7680bdebe9d65fb5c0b6444a2ef14e0a1206b3817792f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art47-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 47,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Conformity assessments shall be carried out in a proportionate manner, avoiding unnecessary burdens for economic operators. Conformity assessment bodies shall perform their activities taking due account of the size of undertakings, in particular as regards microenterprises and small and medium-sized enterprises, the sector in which they operate, their structure, their degree of complexity and the cybersecurity risk level of the products with digital elements and technology in question and the mass or serial nature of the production process.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art47-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 200,
        "source_pinpoint": 47,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art47-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1b8341bca352903d540bb82048e794f9c34c94b4e52cefc493a13e1acad2c82b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art47-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 47,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Notified bodies shall however respect the degree of rigour and the level of protection required for the compliance of products with digital elements with this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art47-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 201,
        "source_pinpoint": 47,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art47-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "9cf5e4bdf5e76fd16cd9082bf22f012f574423c6e1bbd12da8703c12884221da",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art47-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 47,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where a notified body finds that the requirements set out in Annex I or in corresponding harmonised standards or common specifications as referred to in Article 27 have not been met by a manufacturer, it shall require that manufacturer to take appropriate corrective measures and shall not issue a certificate of conformity.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art47-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 202,
        "source_pinpoint": 47,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art47-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "9afb5c1e4c39f2a2e98d601572b6cae378dfea452c94dcf17f0095b323ce9d9b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art47-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 47,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where, in the course of the monitoring of conformity following the issuance of a certificate, a notified body finds that a product with digital elements no longer complies with the requirements laid down in this Regulation, it shall require the manufacturer to take appropriate corrective measures and shall suspend or withdraw the certificate if necessary.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art47-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 203,
        "source_pinpoint": 47,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art47-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "a8b5a00ade2bc6fa14be236b2b854af88d73334570f67e6885d6d29835191db9",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art47-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 47,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Operational obligations of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Where corrective measures are not taken or do not have the required effect, the notified body shall restrict, suspend or withdraw any certificates, as appropriate.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art47-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 204,
        "source_pinpoint": 47,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art47-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "913f989e853597627174dcc85420c30a6f5bf2b9534c32a6a5f38bbb63b14f9e",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art48-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 48,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Appeal against decisions of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Appeal against decisions of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall ensure that an appeal procedure against decisions of the notified bodies is available.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art48-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 205,
        "source_pinpoint": 48,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art48-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1bc5fac9784426a9438a3f5bbd8a273ac37f0bb763bed5223d39e65bc0764cbe",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art49-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 49,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Information obligation on notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Information obligation on notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a certificate;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "any circumstances affecting the scope of and conditions for notification;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "any request for information which they have received from market surveillance authorities regarding conformity assessment activities;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(d)",
            "text": "on request, conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of their notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Notified bodies shall inform the notifying authority of the following: (a) any refusal, restriction, suspension or withdrawal of a certificate; (b) any circumstances affecting the scope of and conditions for notification; (c) any request for information which they have received from market surveillance authorities regarding conformity assessment activities; (d) on request, conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of their notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art49-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 206,
        "source_pinpoint": 49,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art49-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "56ac8f9f1457b6e7529fca1c7a3ca9c03f854f9ca357af9d99c0b99b9f27fc8f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art49-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 49,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Information obligation on notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Information obligation on notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Notified bodies shall provide the other bodies notified under this Regulation carrying out similar conformity assessment activities covering the same products with digital elements with relevant information on issues relating to negative and, upon request, positive conformity assessment results.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art49-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 207,
        "source_pinpoint": 49,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art49-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "ba659b31dfeb9c70a29d9d16f5c533db01995b09102d12c63c7b1c3ae6d042f4",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art50-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 50,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Exchange of experience",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Exchange of experience",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall provide for the organisation of the exchange of experience between the Member States’ national authorities responsible for notification policy.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art50-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 208,
        "source_pinpoint": 50,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art50-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "10d688d99d94d7e465f58f4b05837b00b36cb4cf6aca5eb27f5fe9d6352a0378",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art51-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 51,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Coordination of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Coordination of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall ensure that appropriate coordination and cooperation between notified bodies are put in place and properly operated in the form of a cross-sectoral group of notified bodies.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art51-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 209,
        "source_pinpoint": 51,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art51-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6eafb89b7570fe8c3a1296ee4091c5274d0586694a6f424e95e7ed1a5c0af2c7",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art51-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 51,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Coordination of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Coordination of notified bodies",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER IV"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall ensure that the bodies notified by them participate in the work of that group, directly or by means of designated representatives.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art51-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 210,
        "source_pinpoint": 51,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art51-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "132464c588a31de8b82720fc2e4cdcaedaf13f11f6f9310e4841fe2c0ed2d699",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art52-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 52,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 shall apply to products with digital elements that fall within the scope of this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art52-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 211,
        "source_pinpoint": 52,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art52-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "9a2492f0b1d19b7f6386df5bff64749a30d0a0487d2173421cdabb7f5251f559",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art52-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 52,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Each Member State shall designate one or more market surveillance authorities for the purpose of ensuring the effective implementation of this Regulation. Member States may designate an existing or new authority to act as market surveillance authority for this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art52-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 212,
        "source_pinpoint": 52,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art52-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "be6ce1f6dd1c0ed8b4f25d2cb9cccf191da88046f788947f887118f9b91ae53a",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art52-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 52,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "The market surveillance authorities designated under paragraph 2 of this Article shall also be responsible for carrying out market surveillance activities in relation to the obligations for open-source software stewards laid down in Article 24. Where a market surveillance authority finds that an open-source software steward does not comply with the obligations set out in that Article, it shall require the open-source software steward to ensure that all appropriate corrective actions are taken. Open-source software stewards shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken in respect of their obligations under this Regulation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art52-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 213,
        "source_pinpoint": 52,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art52-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "264e4a33656c4666c8ddbfc054d8a73756440162989a519cb4b503a74fc70ed4",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art52-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 52,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Where relevant, the market surveillance authorities shall cooperate with the national cybersecurity certification authorities designated pursuant to Article 58 of Regulation (EU) 2019/881 and exchange information on a regular basis. With respect to the supervision of the implementation of the reporting obligations pursuant to Article 14 of this Regulation, the designated market surveillance authorities shall cooperate and exchange information on a regular basis with the CSIRTs designated as coordinators and ENISA.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art52-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 214,
        "source_pinpoint": 52,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art52-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "3dd842841156e7def082b48f26e792813d25ea0b8ac94fa14f94e9a404e1af8c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art52-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 52,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "The market surveillance authorities may request a CSIRT designated as coordinator or ENISA to provide technical advice on matters related to the implementation and enforcement of this Regulation. When conducting an investigation under Article 54, market surveillance authorities may request the CSIRT designated as coordinator or ENISA to provide an analysis to support evaluations of compliance of products with digital elements.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art52-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 215,
        "source_pinpoint": 52,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art52-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6b369d13298a3dd0470e0a6ba5c6d9c29d5abb171fae216c6317923a5c804313",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art52-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 52,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Market surveillance and control of products with digital elements in the Union market",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Where relevant, the market surveillance authorities shall cooperate with other market surveillance authorities designated on the basis of Union harmonisation legislation other than this Regulation, and exchange information on a regular basis.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art52-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 216,
        "source_pinpoint": 52,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art52-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "d2223df49f8e470b0423bb5230fd72194e9b6fc1ceb43000ab737f622369f274",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art52-Para7",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 52,
