          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "The market surveillance authorities and, where applicable, the Commission, shall ensure that the agreement to carry out joint activities does not lead to unfair competition between economic operators and does not negatively affect the objectivity, independence and impartiality of the parties to the agreement.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art59-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 264,
        "source_pinpoint": 59,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art59-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "83429544beb85020ce0522a33149a773eb2764d192fb2d890aba372c565e5e4b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art59-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 59,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Joint activities of market surveillance authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Joint activities of market surveillance authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "A market surveillance authority may use any information obtained as a result of the joint activities carried out as part of any investigation that it undertakes.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art59-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 265,
        "source_pinpoint": 59,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art59-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "c717df4b628309bc3f35e153f6e66be7dfff7c5897e6bc6a54d26cae45172c18",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art59-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 59,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Joint activities of market surveillance authorities",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Joint activities of market surveillance authorities",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "The market surveillance authority concerned and, where applicable, the Commission, shall make the agreement on joint activities, including the names of the parties involved, available to the public.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art59-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 266,
        "source_pinpoint": 59,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art59-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "18c46cbaf51922361f65e66c96c6d12fa8c3e057c6e8fa78846ebbfa026d95b5",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art60-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 60,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Market surveillance authorities shall conduct simultaneous coordinated control actions (sweeps) of particular products with digital elements or categories thereof to check compliance with or to detect infringements to this Regulation. Those sweeps may include inspections of products with digital elements acquired under a cover identity.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art60-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 267,
        "source_pinpoint": 60,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art60-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "2df6171726ee036733307bb6cba33c78b78002838b32ef1f1d55c59355c84d21",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art60-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 60,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Unless otherwise agreed upon by the market surveillance authorities involved, sweeps shall be coordinated by the Commission. The coordinator of the sweep shall, where appropriate, make the aggregated results publicly available.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art60-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 268,
        "source_pinpoint": 60,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art60-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "b7ee72e93400c6e9d32a6d6ac19f1d4a70dce483459759df11d75d723917a752",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art60-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 60,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Where, in the performance of its tasks, including based on the notifications received pursuant to Article 14(1) and (3), ENISA identifies categories of products with digital elements for which sweeps may be organised, it shall submit a proposal for a sweep to the coordinator referred to in paragraph 2 of this Article for the consideration of the market surveillance authorities.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art60-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 269,
        "source_pinpoint": 60,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art60-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "b7f58e0b8ffa05cd20273c4ff8d69da800edb45d1172c549c3b3fd1143f7df03",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art60-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 60,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "When conducting sweeps, the market surveillance authorities involved may use the investigation powers set out in Articles 52 to 58 and any other powers conferred upon them by national law.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art60-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 270,
        "source_pinpoint": 60,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art60-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f3d32ff7a307b53d3adb3fcfdf28a1c6ae7a14495084656ac67dc7265d6fdbf9",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art60-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 60,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Sweeps",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER V"
        ],
        "text": "Market surveillance authorities may invite Commission officials, and other accompanying persons authorised by the Commission, to participate in sweeps.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art60-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 271,
        "source_pinpoint": 60,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art60-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "de9f8c9f19a03fae7cdced9acf33cca9ba53ef302408b7ba89b035e17a4f6877",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art61-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 61,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "The power to adopt delegated acts is conferred on the Commission subject to the conditions laid down in this Article.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art61-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 272,
        "source_pinpoint": 61,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art61-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1eb2f7fda6dcd684bc0f789a4be7ee0cf97a9edcbabe64d9d51258ad40e21797",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art61-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 61,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Article 2(5), second subparagraph, Article 7(3), Article 8(1) and (2), Article 13(8), fourth subparagraph, Article 14(9), Article 25, Article 27(9), Article 28(5) and Article 31(5) shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from 10 December 2024. The Commission shall draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power shall be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art61-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 273,
        "source_pinpoint": 61,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art61-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "55cd2ec0598c6feed4d57858486689b3215731110757b5846096496c0e31d2be",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art61-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 61,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "The delegation of power referred to in Article 2(5), second subparagraph, Article 7(3), Article 8(1) and (2), Article 13(8), fourth subparagraph, Article 14(9), Article 25, Article 27(9), Article 28(5) and Article 31(5) may be revoked at any time by the European Parliament or by the Council. A decision to revoke shall put an end to the delegation of the power specified in that decision. It shall take effect the day following the publication of the decision in the Official Journal of the European Union or at a later date specified therein. It shall not affect the validity of any delegated acts already in force.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art61-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 274,
        "source_pinpoint": 61,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art61-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "bb023a8217cdd78e275bbd7c7dbc1f44ed88a1877aeb9ddb21a63ce4e48edcd3",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art61-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 61,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "Before adopting a delegated act, the Commission shall consult experts designated by each Member State in accordance with principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of 13 April 2016 on Better Law-Making.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art61-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 275,
        "source_pinpoint": 61,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art61-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "2329bff87081951f966130661b251f095883408c0b2571312204218ff291fedf",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art61-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 61,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "As soon as it adopts a delegated act, the Commission shall notify it simultaneously to the European Parliament and to the Council.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art61-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 276,
        "source_pinpoint": 61,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art61-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "288f2f93767bec3e20501a22d3b326e8dd0761eee3351ecdb147910cd64664d6",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art61-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 61,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Exercise of the delegation",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "A delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 2(5), second subparagraph, Article 7(3), Article 8(1) or (2), Article 13(8), fourth subparagraph, Article 14(9), Article 25, Article 27(9), Article 28(5) or Article 31(5) shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or by the Council within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and to the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by two months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art61-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 277,
        "source_pinpoint": 61,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art61-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "7809572238e8610dff09ceb75981ba24112a4b2370052ae9734d7127ceafb7ff",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art62-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 62,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Committee procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Committee procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission shall be assisted by a committee. That committee shall be a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art62-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 278,
        "source_pinpoint": 62,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art62-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "af92565a91aadfa3ef0c8ce2946380f0dbf61719754e441b0c06c590bdde3491",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art62-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 62,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Committee procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Committee procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "Where reference is made to this paragraph, Article 5 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 shall apply.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art62-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 279,
        "source_pinpoint": 62,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art62-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "884285217a174c68781989a9d6c15f714239e670507a33b75f5bdc2c6f562d52",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art62-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 62,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Committee procedure",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Committee procedure",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VI"
        ],
        "text": "Where the opinion of the committee is to be obtained by written procedure, that procedure shall be terminated without result when, within the time-limit for delivery of the opinion, the chair of the committee so decides or a committee member so requests.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art62-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 280,
        "source_pinpoint": 62,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art62-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "7c5f2be846d0f82bc25e158ae564c7d673b6e8869715434605f401486b37c2d7",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art63-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 63,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "intellectual property rights and confidential business information or trade secrets of a natural or legal person, including source code, except the cases referred to in Article 5 of Directive (EU) 2016/943 of the European Parliament and of the Council (37);"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "the effective implementation of this Regulation, in particular for the purposes of inspections, investigations or audits;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "public and national security interests;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(d)",
            "text": "integrity of criminal or administrative proceedings."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "All parties involved in the application of this Regulation shall respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out their tasks and activities in such a manner as to protect, in particular: (a) intellectual property rights and confidential business information or trade secrets of a natural or legal person, including source code, except the cases referred to in Article 5 of Directive (EU) 2016/943 of the European Parliament and of the Council (37); (b) the effective implementation of this Regulation, in particular for the purposes of inspections, investigations or audits; (c) public and national security interests; (d) integrity of criminal or administrative proceedings.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art63-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 281,
        "source_pinpoint": 63,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art63-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "e4bf93ddc9e104e4f9dbd47703cd04f1b361e99f81b6e5258b8d0f27da03d188",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art63-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 63,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Without prejudice to paragraph 1, information exchanged on a confidential basis between the market surveillance authorities and between market surveillance authorities and the Commission shall not be disclosed without the prior agreement of the originating market surveillance authority.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art63-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 282,
        "source_pinpoint": 63,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art63-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "2c0d54a15bdbca587c10093a881cf0a1789bf5273a7610eeedae6a0ef7808c0f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art63-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 63,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not affect the rights and obligations of the Commission, Member States and notified bodies with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings, nor the obligations of the persons concerned to provide information under criminal law of the Member States.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art63-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 283,
        "source_pinpoint": 63,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art63-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "9871e44ab1a7fac8d8adcfa2ab86f1fbb5e2f6469ca5f8d4b58459693a459048",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art63-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 63,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Confidentiality",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "The Commission and Member States may exchange, where necessary, sensitive information with relevant authorities of third countries with which they have concluded bilateral or multilateral confidentiality arrangements guaranteeing an adequate level of protection.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art63-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 284,
        "source_pinpoint": 63,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art63-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "b09c8e9f521de06b50b7ea8be76ce37fd0292580f7ed80cf8951b70880975c7f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Member States shall lay down the rules on penalties applicable to infringements of this Regulation and shall take all measures necessary to ensure that they are implemented. The penalties provided for shall be effective, proportionate and dissuasive. Member States shall, without delay, notify the Commission of those rules and measures and shall notify it, without delay, of any subsequent amendment affecting them.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 285,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "48f3469eb08d31ad223d9638eebeed9697a990a142b662e3c041ce0859758bc2",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Non-compliance with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I and the obligations set out in Articles 13 and 14 shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 15 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 2,5 % of the its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 286,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "88dadd03972842f99841c989d14a4391c44b0847976358743604ec9b62c5c903",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Non-compliance with the obligations set out in Articles 18 to 23, Article 28, Article 30(1) to (4), Article 31(1) to (4), Article 32(1), (2) and (3), Article 33(5), and Articles 39, 41, 47, 49 and 53 shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 10 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 2 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 287,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "d47b3f1d6d59936e716d27c586d229ad089a65a24cd19f82f7dbb35fb43ba194",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para4",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "4",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "The supply of incorrect, incomplete or misleading information to notified bodies and market surveillance authorities in reply to a request shall be subject to administrative fines of up to EUR 5 000 000 or, if the offender is an undertaking, up to 1 % of its total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para4",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 288,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para4"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "aea18bd128ad612b38168dcc91810efe79a9292cb9ba44f0dd24d5ce5619750c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para5",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "5",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "whether administrative fines have been already applied by the same or other market surveillance authorities to the same economic operator for a similar infringement;"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(c)",
            "text": "the size, in particular with regard to microenterprises and small and medium sized-enterprises, including start-ups, and the market share of the economic operator committing the infringement."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "When deciding on the amount of the administrative fine in each individual case, all relevant circumstances of the specific situation shall be taken into account and due regard shall be given to the following: (a) the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement and of its consequences; (b) whether administrative fines have been already applied by the same or other market surveillance authorities to the same economic operator for a similar infringement; (c) the size, in particular with regard to microenterprises and small and medium sized-enterprises, including start-ups, and the market share of the economic operator committing the infringement.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para5",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 289,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para5"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1a6993cce12d8330d1c6db57385e64aeb7486eef4e069736aaf06654b60e889b",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para6",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "6",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Market surveillance authorities that apply administrative fines shall communicate that application to the market surveillance authorities of other Member States through the information and communication system referred to in Article 34 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para6",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 290,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para6"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f6561b581ec88d9f66ad6b86b40f19965579124ba76842a864c0cc1c14622806",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para7",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "7",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Each Member State shall lay down rules on whether and to what extent administrative fines may be imposed on public authorities and public bodies established in that Member State.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para7",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 291,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para7"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "5c20fd6830b2fdb8dfcebd459b76eff20be384f06d43dfb362ba9f27ab9515d3",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para8",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "8",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Depending on the legal system of the Member States, the rules on administrative fines may be applied in such a manner that the fines are imposed by competent national courts or other bodies according to the competences established at national level in those Member States. The application of such rules in those Member States shall have an equivalent effect.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para8",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 292,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para8"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "5613a726dada1743401584501319d606c3f548158a8c45e5f8508302ba1877e5",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para9",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "9",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Administrative fines may be imposed, depending on the circumstances of each individual case, in addition to any other corrective or restrictive measures applied by the market surveillance authorities for the same infringement.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para9",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 293,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para9"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "5349e4d1c6f7cb07a512ac93ad612460a1dc557d121fab7925395acec5c7be69",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art64-Para10",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 64,
        "paragraph_number": "10",
        "article_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Penalties",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(a)",
            "text": "manufacturers that qualify as microenterprises or small enterprises with regard to any failure to meet the deadline referred to in Article 14(2), point (a), or Article 14(4), point (a);"
          },
          {
            "type": "point",
            "marker": "(b)",
            "text": "any infringement of this Regulation by open-source software stewards."
          }
        ],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "By way of derogation from paragraphs 3 to 9, the administrative fines referred to in those paragraphs shall not apply to the following: (a) manufacturers that qualify as microenterprises or small enterprises with regard to any failure to meet the deadline referred to in Article 14(2), point (a), or Article 14(4), point (a); (b) any infringement of this Regulation by open-source software stewards.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art64-Para10",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 294,
        "source_pinpoint": 64,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art64-Para10"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "f238228fcf54d43090daeda20ece16449b6fdb354e5b43cb8dbbe5ce333e507c",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art65-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 65,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Representative actions",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Representative actions",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VII"
        ],
        "text": "Directive (EU) 2020/1828 shall apply to the representative actions brought against infringements by economic operators of provisions of this Regulation that harm, or may harm, the collective interests of consumers.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art65-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 295,
        "source_pinpoint": 65,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art65-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "92b222624973a9dab7161b5d14345b2a8702bbc9db5139562fb33906580c325f",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art66-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 66,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Amendment to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Amendment to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "amending",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "In Annex I to Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, the following point is added: ‘72. Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 of the European Parliament and of the Council (*). (*) Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2024 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements and amending Regulations (EU) No 168/2013 and (EU) No 2019/1020 and Directive (EU) 2020/1828 (Cyber Resilience Act) (OJ L, 2024/2847, 20.11.2024, ELI: http://data. europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj).’.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art66-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 296,
        "source_pinpoint": 66,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art66-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "79867b18cf98b86a583be8cbf19553a8dd020f4b5784f5c2989413ffea2b0c09",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art67-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 67,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Amendment to Directive (EU) 2020/1828",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Amendment to Directive (EU) 2020/1828",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "amending",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "In Annex I to Directive (EU) 2020/1828, the following point is added: ‘69. Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 of the European Parliament and of the Council (*). (*) Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 October 2024 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements and amending Regulations (EU) No 168/2013 and (EU) No 2019/1020 and Directive (EU) 2020/1828 (Cyber Resilience Act) (OJ L, 2024/2847, 20.11.2024, ELI: http://data. europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/2847/oj).’.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art67-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 297,
        "source_pinpoint": 67,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art67-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "6a1505361041cac70261d8b25fcff1129e11d12a299b87139936e2be6c4db2ec",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art68-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 68,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Amendment to Regulation (EU) No 168/2013",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Amendment to Regulation (EU) No 168/2013",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "single",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "amending",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "In Part C1, in the table, of Annex II to Regulation (EU) No 168/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council (38), the following entry is added: ‘ 16 18 protection of vehicle against x x x x x x x x x x x x x x cyberattacks ’.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art68-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 298,
        "source_pinpoint": 68,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art68-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "1daf5c251fe139221794eafad6a4985994955e932b57afb848a3147fc9f5f74d",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art69-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 69,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Transitional provisions",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Transitional provisions",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "EU type-examination certificates and approval decisions issued regarding cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements that are subject to Union harmonisation legislation other than this Regulation shall remain valid until 11 June 2028, unless they expire before that date, or unless otherwise specified in such other Union harmonisation legislation, in which case they shall remain valid as referred to in that legislation.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art69-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 299,
        "source_pinpoint": 69,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art69-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "73a8eb5db6dc54a3d6fb33b4110776e19d23722a99979052aeb458436bbf02da",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art69-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 69,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Transitional provisions",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Transitional provisions",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "Products with digital elements that have been placed on the market before 11 December 2027 shall be subject to the requirements set out in this Regulation only if, from that date, those products are subject to a substantial modification.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art69-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 300,
        "source_pinpoint": 69,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art69-Para2"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "415a5ac32f4573821ad2852e576a9ad9b4fdfc3f91210f731b2f0c1cd87e77a1",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art69-Para3",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 69,
        "paragraph_number": "3",
        "article_heading": "Transitional provisions",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Transitional provisions",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "By way of derogation from paragraph 2 of this Article, the obligations laid down in Article 14 shall apply to all products with digital elements that fall within the scope of this Regulation that have been placed on the market before 11 December 2027.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art69-Para3",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 301,
        "source_pinpoint": 69,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art69-Para3"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],
        "text_sha256": "8bd94cf717b52d3995393fa007a24826e543033820bc73470b63cd1edf5866f2",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art70-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 70,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Evaluation and review",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Evaluation and review",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "By 11 December 2030 and every four years thereafter, the Commission shall submit a report on the evaluation and review of this Regulation to the European Parliament and to the Council. Those reports shall be made public.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art70-Para1",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 302,
        "source_pinpoint": 70,
        "source_locator": {
          "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
          "producer_id": "article-Art70-Para1"
        },
        "source_attribution_ids": [
          "source-eurlex-pdf"
        ],

      {
        "id": "article-Art70-Para2",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 70,
        "paragraph_number": "2",
        "article_heading": "Evaluation and review",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Evaluation and review",
        "akn4eu_paragraph_kind": "numbered",
        "akn4eu_article_kind": "regular",
        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "By 11 September 2028, the Commission shall, after consulting ENISA and the CSIRTs network, submit a report to the European Parliament and to the Council, assessing the effectiveness of the single reporting platform set out in Article 16, as well as the impact of the application of the cybersecurity-related grounds referred to Article 16(2) by the CSIRTs designated as coordinators on the effectiveness of the single reporting platform as regards the timely dissemination of received notifications to other relevant CSIRTs.",
        "outbound_relations": [],
        "inbound_relations": [],
        "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art70-Para2",
        "unit_type": "paragraph",
        "sequence": 303,
        "source_pinpoint": 70,

          "producer_id": "article-Art70-Para2"
        },

        ],
        "text_sha256": "2e1c841459ca30534f85ef2e683dbfc5da35f3801661ab92e52efb4b255df040",
        "text_completeness": "complete"
      },
      {
        "id": "article-Art71-Para1",
        "type": "article_paragraph",
        "article_number": 71,
        "paragraph_number": "1",
        "article_heading": "Entry into force and application",
        "akn4eu_heading": "Entry into force and application",

        "akn4eu_sub_units": [],
        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"
        ],
        "text": "This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.",

        "inbound_relations": [],

        "ancestry": [
          "CHAPTER VIII"

        "text": "This Regulation shall apply from 11 December 2027. However, Article 14 shall apply from 11 September 2026 and Chapter IV (Articles 35 to 51) shall apply from 11 June 2026.",

    {
      "id": "annex-I-PartII-unnumbered-18",

      "point": "PartII-unnumbered-18",
      "source_label": null,
      "parent_point": "annex-I-PartII",
      "title": null,
      "text": "Manufacturers of products with digital elements shall:",
      "akn4eu_structural_type": "paragraph",
      "akn4eu_headerofannex_ref": "ANNEX I",
      "ancestry": [
        "annex-I",
        "annex-I-PartII"
      ],
      "outbound_relations": [

          "target": "annex-I-PartII",
          "relation": "part_of",

        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/annex-I-PartII-unnumbered-18",
      "unit_type": "annex_point",
      "sequence": 19,
      "source_pinpoint": "annex-I-PartII-unnumbered-18",

      ],

      "text_completeness": "complete"
    },
    {
      "id": "annex-I-PartII-1",
      "type": "annex_point",
      "annex": "I",
      "point": "PartII-1",
      "source_label": "(1)",
      "parent_point": "annex-I-PartII",
      "title": "identify and document vulnerabilities and components contained in products with digital elements, including by",
      "text": "(1) identify and document vulnerabilities and components contained in products with digital elements, including by drawing up a software bill of materials in a commonly used and machine-readable format covering at the very least the top-level dependencies of the products;",
      "akn4eu_structural_type": "level",
      "akn4eu_headerofannex_ref": "ANNEX I",
      "ancestry": [
        "annex-I",
        "annex-I-PartII"
      ],
      "outbound_relations": [
        {
          "source": "annex-I-PartII-1",
          "target": "annex-I-PartII",
          "relation": "part_of",
          "structural_export_only": true
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/annex-I-PartII-1",
      "unit_type": "annex_point",
      "sequence": 20,
      "source_pinpoint": "(1)",
      "source_locator": {
        "manifestation_id": "manifestation-eurlex-pdf-32024R2847-en",
        "producer_id": "annex-I-PartII-1"
      },
      "source_attribution_ids": [
        "source-eurlex-pdf"
      ],
      "text_sha256": "9db38df09d4df8ddb0b50ac784f29bf41d980648548280dcaed11d6b1b2394db",
      "text_completeness": "complete"
    },
    {
      "id": "annex-I-PartII-2",
      "type": "annex_point",
      "annex": "I",
      "point": "PartII-2",
      "source_label": "(2)",
      "parent_point": "annex-I-PartII",
      "title": "in relation to the risks posed to products with digital elements, address and remediate vulnerabilities without delay,",
      "text": "(2) in relation to the risks posed to products with digital elements, address and remediate vulnerabilities without delay, including by providing security updates; where technically feasible, new security updates shall be provided separately from functionality updates;",
      "akn4eu_structural_type": "level",
      "akn4eu_headerofannex_ref": "ANNEX I",
      "ancestry": [
        "annex-I",
        "annex-I-PartII"

      "outbound_relations": [

          "source": "annex-I-PartII-2",

          "structural_export_only": true
        }
      ],
      "inbound_relations": [],
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/annex-I-PartII-2",
      "unit_type": "annex_point",
      "sequence": 21,
      "source_pinpoint": "(2)",
      "source_locator": {

        "producer_id": "annex-I-PartII-2"
      },
      "source_attribution_ids": [

      ],

      "text_completeness": "complete"
    },
    {

      "annex": "I",
      "point": "PartII-3",
      "source_label": "(3)",
      "parent_point": "annex-I-PartII",
      "title": "apply effective and regular tests and reviews of the security of the product with digital elements;",
      "text": "(3) apply effective and regular tests and reviews of the security of the product with digital elements;",
      "akn4eu_structural_type": "level",
      "akn4eu_headerofannex_ref": "ANNEX I",
      "ancestry": [

      "inbound_relations": [],
      "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/annex-I-PartII-3",
      "unit_type": "annex_point",

      "source_pinpoint": "(3)",

      "source_attribution_ids": [

      "text_completeness": "complete"
    },
    {
      "id": "annex-I-PartII-4",
      "type": "annex_point",
      "annex": "I",
      "point": "PartII-4",
      "source_label": "(4)",
      "parent_point": "annex-I-PartII",
      "title": "once a security update has been made available, share and publicly disclose information about fixed vulnerabilities,",
      "text": "(4) once a security update has been made available, share and publicly disclose information about fixed vulnerabilities, including a description of the vulnerabilities, information allowing users to identify the product with digital elements affected, the impacts of the vulnerabilities, their severity and clear and accessible information helping users to remediate the vulnerabilities; in duly justified cases, where manufacturers consider the security risks of publication to outweigh the security benefits, they may delay making public information regarding a fixed vulnerability until after users have been given the possibility to apply the relevant patch;",
      "akn4eu_structural_type": "level",
      "akn4eu_headerofannex_ref": "ANNEX I",
      "ancestry": [
        "annex-I",
        "annex-I-PartII"

    {

      "source_label": null,
      "parent_point": "annex-VIII-PartIV-3.3",
      "title": null,
      "text": "In addition to experience in quality management systems, the auditing team shall have at least one member experienced as an assessor in the relevant product field and product technology concerned, and shall have knowledge of the applicable requirements set out in this Regulation. The audit shall include an assessment visit to the manufacturer’s premises, where such premises exist. The auditing team shall review the technical documentation referred to in point 3.1 (b), to verify the manufacturer’s ability to identify the applicable requirements set out in this Regulation and to carry out the necessary examinations with a view to ensuring compliance of the product with digital elements with those requirements.",

      "relation": "concretizes",
      "confidence": "high",
      "reasoning": "Recital 114 describes sweeps as coordinated market-surveillance enforcement and identifies risk indications that justify selecting products, concretising Article 60(1)’s compliance-checking and infringement-detection mandate.",
      "source_quote": "Simultaneous coordinated control actions (sweeps) are specific enforcement actions by market surveillance authorities that can further enhance product security. Sweeps should, in particular, be conducted where market trends, consumer complaints or other indications suggest that certain categories of products with digital elements are often found to present cybersecurity risks. Furthermore, when determining the product categories to be subjected to sweeps, market surveillance authorities should also take into account circumstances relating to non-technical risk factors. To that end, market surveillance authorities should be able to take into account the results of Union level coordinated security risk assessments of critical supply chains carried out in accordance with Article 22 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555, including circumstances relating to non-technical risk factors. ENISA should submit proposals for categories of products with digital elements for which sweeps could be organised to the market surveillance authorities, based, inter alia, on the notifications of vulnerabilities and incidents it receives.",
      "target_quote": "Market surveillance authorities shall conduct simultaneous coordinated control actions (sweeps) of particular products with digital elements or categories thereof to check compliance with or to detect infringements to this Regulation. Those sweeps may include inspections of products with digital elements acquired under a cover identity.",

          "quote_verbatim": "Simultaneous coordinated control actions (sweeps) are specific enforcement actions by market surveillance authorities that can further enhance product security. Sweeps should, in particular, be conducted where market trends, consumer complaints or other indications suggest that certain categories of products with digital elements are often found to present cybersecurity risks. Furthermore, when determining the product categories to be subjected to sweeps, market surveillance authorities should also take into account circumstances relating to non-technical risk factors. To that end, market surveillance authorities should be able to take into account the results of Union level coordinated security risk assessments of critical supply chains carried out in accordance with Article 22 of Directive (EU) 2022/2555, including circumstances relating to non-technical risk factors. ENISA should submit proposals for categories of products with digital elements for which sweeps could be organised to the market surveillance authorities, based, inter alia, on the notifications of vulnerabilities and incidents it receives.",
          "quote_sha256": "03fdc7f6ae8a0eed2cf0d3a9a2640651f33e1ffe84a971d32903dc0a722991ca",
          "char_start": 0,
          "char_end": 1123,
          "source_pinpoint": 114,
          "source_attribution_id": "source-eurlex-pdf"
        },

          "node_id": "article-Art60-Para1",
          "canonical_ref": "celex:32024R2847/article-Art60-Para1",
          "quote_verbatim": "Market surveillance authorities shall conduct simultaneous coordinated control actions (sweeps) of particular products with digital elements or categories thereof to check compliance with or to detect infringements to this Regulation.       "relation": "concretizes",
      "confidence": "high",
      "reasoning": "Recital 117 identifies a delegated power to set category-specific minimum support periods where surveillance data shows inadequacy, mirroring the conditional power in Article 13(8).",
      "source_quote": "In order to ensure that the regulatory framework can be adapted where necessary, the power to adopt acts in accordance with Article 290 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) should be delegated to the Commission in respect of updating an annex to this Regulation listing the important products with digital elements. Power to adopt acts in accordance with that Article should be delegated to the Commission to identify products with digital elements covered by other Union rules which achieve the same level of protection as this Regulation, specifying whether a limitation or exclusion from the scope of this Regulation would be necessary as well as the scope of that limitation, if applicable. Power to adopt acts in accordance with that Article should also be delegated to the Commission in respect of the potential mandating of certification under a European cybersecurity certification scheme of the critical products with digital elements set out in an annex to this Regulation, as well as for updating the list of critical products with digital elements based on criticality criteria set out in this Regulation, and for specifying the European cybersecurity certification schemes adopted pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 that can be used to demonstrate conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements or parts thereof as set out in an annex to this Regulation. Power to adopt acts should also be delegated to the Commission to specify the minimum support period for specific product categories where the market surveillance data suggests inadequate support periods, as well as to specify the terms and conditions for applying the cybersecurity-related grounds in relation to delaying the dissemination of notifications of actively exploited vulnerabilities. Furthermore, power to adopt acts should be delegated to the Commission to establish voluntary security attestation programmes for assessing the conformity of products with digital elements qualifying as free and open-source software with all or certain essential cybersecurity requirements or other obligations laid down in this Regulation, as well as to specify the minimum content of the EU declaration of conformity and to supplement the elements to be included in the technical documentation. It is of particular importance that the Commission carry out appropriate consultations during its preparatory work, including at expert level, and that those consultations be conducted in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of 13 April 2016 on Better Law-Making (31). In particular, to ensure equal participation in the preparation of delegated acts, the European Parliament and the Council receive all documents at the same time as Member States’ experts, and their experts systematically have access to meetings of Commission expert groups dealing with the preparation of delegated acts. The power to adopt delegated acts pursuant to this Regulation should be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from 10 December 2024. The Commission should draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The delegation of power should be tacitly extended for periods of an identical duration, unless the European Parliament or the Council opposes such extension not later than three months before the end of each period.",
      "target_quote": "Manufacturers shall ensure, when placing a product with digital elements on the market, and for the support period, that vulnerabilities of that product, including its components, are handled effectively and in accordance with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Part II of Annex I. Manufacturers shall determine the support period so that it reflects the length of time during which the product is expected to be in use, taking into account, in particular, reasonable user expectations, the nature of the product, including its intended purpose, as well as relevant Union law determining the lifetime of products with digital elements. When determining the support period, manufacturers may also take into account the support periods of products with digital elements offering a similar functionality placed on the market by other manufacturers, the availability of the operating environment, the support periods of integrated components that provide core functions and are sourced from third parties as well as relevant guidance provided by the dedicated administrative cooperation group (ADCO) established pursuant to Article 52(15) and the Commission. The matters to be taken into account in order to determine the support period shall be considered in a manner that ensures proportionality. Without prejudice to the second subparagraph, the support period shall be at least five years. Where the product with digital elements is expected to be in use for less than five years, the support period shall correspond to the expected use time. Taking into account ADCO recommendations as referred to in Article 52(16), the Commission may adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 61 to supplement this Regulation by specifying the minimum support period for specific product categories where the market surveillance data suggests inadequate support periods. Manufacturers shall include the information that was taken into account to determine the support period of a product with digital elements in the technical documentation as set out in Annex VII. Manufacturers shall have appropriate policies and procedures, including coordinated vulnerability disclosure policies, referred to in Part II, point (5), of Annex I to process and remediate potential vulnerabilities in the product with digital elements reported from internal or external sources.",

      "reasoning": "Recital 117’s voluntary security-attestation programme for free and open-source software restates the delegated programme established by Article 25(1).",
      "source_quote": "In order to ensure that the regulatory framework can be adapted where necessary, the power to adopt acts in accordance with Article 290 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union (TFEU) should be delegated to the Commission in respect of updating an annex to this Regulation listing the important products with digital elements. Power to adopt acts in accordance with that Article should be delegated to the Commission to identify products with digital elements covered by other Union rules which achieve the same level of protection as this Regulation, specifying whether a limitation or exclusion from the scope of this Regulation would be necessary as well as the scope of that limitation, if applicable. Power to adopt acts in accordance with that Article should also be delegated to the Commission in respect of the potential mandating of certification under a European cybersecurity certification scheme of the critical products with digital elements set out in an annex to this Regulation, as well as for updating the list of critical products with digital elements based on criticality criteria set out in this Regulation, and for specifying the European cybersecurity certification schemes adopted pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 that can be used to demonstrate conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements or parts thereof as set out in an annex to this Regulation. Power to adopt acts should also be delegated to the Commission to specify the minimum support period for specific product categories where the market surveillance data suggests inadequate support periods, as well as to specify the terms and conditions for applying the cybersecurity-related grounds in relation to delaying the dissemination of notifications of actively exploited vulnerabilities. Furthermore, power to adopt acts should be delegated to the Commission to establish voluntary security attestation programmes for assessing the conformity of products with digital elements qualifying as free and open-source software with all or certain essential cybersecurity requirements or other obligations laid down in this Regulation, as well as to specify the minimum content of the EU declaration of conformity and to supplement the elements to be included in the technical documentation. It is of particular importance that the Commission carry out appropriate consultations during its preparatory work, including at expert level, and that those consultations be conducted in accordance with the principles laid down in the Interinstitutional Agreement of 13 April 2016 on Better Law-Making (31). In particular, to ensure equal participation in the preparation of delegated acts, the European Parliament and the Council receive all documents at the same time as Member States’ experts, and their experts systematically have access to meetings of Commission expert groups dealing with the preparation of delegated acts. The power to adopt delegated acts pursuant to this Regulation should be conferred on the Commission for a period of five years from 10 December 2024. The Commission should draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period. The Commission should draw up a report in respect of the delegation of power not later than nine months before the end of the five-year period.       "target_quote": "The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 61 to supplement this Regulation to determine which products with digital elements that have the core functionality of a product category that is set out in Annex IV to this Regulation are to be required to obtain a European cybersecurity certificate at assurance level at least ‘substantial’ under a European cybersecurity certification scheme adopted pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881, to demonstrate conformity with the essential cybersecurity requirements set out in Annex I to this Regulation or parts thereof, provided that a European cybersecurity certification scheme covering those categories of products with digital elements has been adopted pursuant to Regulation (EU) 2019/881 and is available to manufacturers. Those delegated acts shall specify the required assurance level that shall be proportionate to the level of cybersecurity risk associated with the products with digital elements and shall take account of their intended purpose, including the critical dependency on them by essential entities as referred to in Article 3(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Before adopting such delegated acts, the Commission shall carry out an assessment of the potential market impact of the envisaged measures and shall carry out consultations with relevant stakeholders, including the European Cybersecurity Certification Group established under Regulation (EU) 2019/881. The assessment shall take into account the readiness and the capacity level of the Member States for the implementation of the relevant European cybersecurity certification scheme. Where no delegated acts as referred to in the first subparagraph of this paragraph have been adopted, products with digital elements which have the core functionality of a product category as set out in Annex IV shall be subject to the conformity assessment procedures referred to in Article 32(3).
